181000.description:
"Do I have to run away again?"

School teacher Yumi is back in her hometown. She's heard that her old elementary school uses "The Handbook of Morality" in their curriculum, and she's excited to start teaching there. But after running into an old classmate, Yumi is reminded of a past she's desperately tried to forget...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 道徳と道標～あの学校の秘密～

181001.description:
A world where age is just a number.
College student Soong has a secret: she’s 121 years old. With the invention of a wonder drug, anyone can look 21 again. And in a world without visible aging, why act your age? Anything is possible — even a romance with a man 100 years your junior.

(Source: Manta)

181002.description:
Seon-Min seems like an ordinary college student, but behind closed doors, she lives a secret life as her professor's plaything. When Yu-Jin, the student she tutors, discovers her darkest secret, everything begins to fall apart. Seon-Min's campus life begins to unravel, plunging her once-stable existence into chaos.

(Source: Lezhin US)

181006.description:
A story about a cute god from another world making you feel slimy and tingly.

(Source: FAKKU!)

Note: Published in Weekly Kairakuten 2020-10

181007.description:
Aruka, a silver-haired, blue-eyed girl, somehow finds herself becoming a goddess!

Even so, she still gets hungry, so she spends her days secretly eating strange creatures. Then she meets Akira, a boy who doesn't go to school. He lives listlessly at home and attracts strange creatures, which makes him useful for Aruka…!

This is a story of friendship, pure but strange, revolving around an unusual goddess.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note:
- Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.
- Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: A Deity Stands with A Ghost

181008.description: A self-proclaimed sex genius, but actually a loli hag virgin of unknown age. This is a story about a wicked god spending time with the believers every day in order to receive tribute, which is becoming increasingly scarce.???

181009.description:
Life and death...A hospital that will send you to Heaven. ❤

(Source: FAKKU!)

Note: Published in Weekly Kairakuten 2021-01

181012.description:
Harem life begins for James, a returning college student, with a stable of foxy cougars!

"Were older women supposed to be this sexy?!"

(Source: DAYcomics)
synonyms: 年上だけど、抱いてくれますか？
ジャンルはメロドラマ

title.native: ゲーミングPCみたいに光るタコ
title.romaji: Gaming PC Mitai ni Hikaru Tako

title.native: アルカリレットウセイ

181016.description:
Ruri is a clumsy ninja who fails almost every mission. But Ruri remains undaunted, all for the sake of her ailing younger sister, Murasaki. One day, Ruri learns that there is a 100,000-ryo bounty on the head of Tokuyama Tenryori, the shogun of Edo, who lives in an impregnable castle full of traps and sorcery. The battle for Edo Castle is about to begin!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

181017.description:
The scenery before the eldest son of the family head looked like it was from 500 years ago, during the Joseon Dynasty.

“To go back, I have to be with a widow?!”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: 夜伽物語～ご先祖からヤれと言われまして～

181018.description:
What could make a romance fantasy superfan happier than getting pulled into a fantasy world? But Daline Este’s dreams of being the protagonist in her story come crashing down when reality sinks in. She hasn’t been pulled into one of her favorite novels like she dreamed—instead, she's landed in a world on the cusp of crisis as several novels tangle together and threaten to tear it apart. Now, Daline must use her expertise to set the stories straight before her happy ending goes up in flames.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: If You Don't Know the Novel, You Will Die

181019.description:
Grandma said that good things come to those who live honestly, but my life ended in some car accident. Luckily, I was given a second chance to live an upright life! And so I found myself in the body of Everdeen Usher, a woman who fled home to avoid marrying into a ducal house. Wait, I’m a noble?! Oh crap, my fiancé’s older brother is demanding I pay back the dowry my useless father took! With all the odds against me, can I live an honest life and reach a different ending this time?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Tried to Live an Honest Life

181020.description:
My first love, her name is Koga Gumomo.

She was so much more beautiful and mature than a typical high school student, which attracted a great deal of jealousy and dislike. So much so that she was on the verge of jumping off the rooftop because of all the bullying she received.

So, what can I do to help?

"Why not have s*x with me!"
"............, you pervert! ...... (yuck!)"
"Maybe so! But are you sure? If you die here, your last memory will be the confession of some pervert you don't even know! It would ruin the mood!"
"............, what have you done! You pervert!"
"I have my reasons. Because I love you more than anything in the world! Let's get married!"
"What, ehhhh~~~............?"

I will yell out my love until I die, if it will make a place for you in this world!

The most stupid and straightforward protagonist in the history of romantic comedies and the cool, sullen JK will hook up for a romantic comedy with a sugar content of 100%!

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Just before jumping, I suggested to my classmate, "Let's have sex!"

title.native: 飛び降りる直前の同級生に「×××しよう！」と提案してみた。
title.romaji: Tobioriru Chokuzen no Doukyuusei ni "XXX Shiyou!" to Teian Shitemita.

181021.description:
On his first day at Nakseong High, Lee Jun enters more than a new environment. After a status window warns him of the school's horror stories, he is killed in a wave of gore and sent back to his first day. This time, Jun ignores the ominous window and tricks fate, only to be killed again three years later, forced to restart high school, and lead a brand-new horror story club. Pulled into this life-and-death game, can Jun rewrite the Nakseong urban legend once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: 底辺おっさん、チート覚醒で異世界楽々ライフ
title.romaji: Teihen Ossan, Cheat Kakusei de Isekai Rakuraku Life

181023.description:
You’re kidding me, right? Why are there two of you, Ban Yeri…?! Both Yeris are saying they’re the real one. People will notice if we’re both out and about… Minwoo, can we stay at your place?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

181024.description:
"You're just a manager. Why are you so hot?"

Seo-Jun became Seo-Yeon's manager because he wanted to see his favorite streamer in person. But unlike what he imagined, his days are filled with pain from relentless abuse and violence. Then one day, after turning from one of her fans into a full-on anti and posting hateful comments, an affection-building app suddenly gets installed on his phone. And the mission is to... "Fuck Seo-Yeon?"

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)
synonyms: The BJ Manager Who Boosts His Favorability

181025.description:
In my reality, my dick was small, but in this other world, it’s huge?! But, the way they’re looking at my body is giving me a bad feeling…!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: Reproducing Till My Dick Falls Off

181026.description:
A young boy must live in exile lest his deadly magical powers destroy the world.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.native: ベノム 求愛性少女症候群
貞操逆転異世界でスケベな美女たちに囲まれながら冒険者生活
title.romaji: Teisou Gyakuten Isekai de Sukebe na Bijotachi ni Kakomarenagara Boukensha Seikatsu

181029.description:
A meteorite crashes into Earth, carrying the mysterious monster “Acrylamide” that threatens humanity. The only hope are the “Magical Girls” who have the power to fight Acrylamide! The high school boy Act supports his sister Shiyin, also known as Magical Girl Shiny, in her fight against the monsters, until one day when she is defeated and killed. Now what will Act do to get his sister back…? A time-traveling comic with a sis-con brother and law-breaking magical girl!

(Source: YK Ours, translated)
synonyms: My Sister Will Not Become a Magical Girl

title.native: うちの子は魔法少女にならない
title.romaji: Uchi no Ko wa Mahou Shoujo ni Naranai

title.native: バスタード・ソードマン

181032.description:
"The Dead King has been born." The imperial harem situated in the empire of Daikou (Da Guang) had launched into an uproar.

Inside the coffin of an imperial concubine who was rumored to have been murdered, a baby's corpse was found. On the orders of the empress, Enmei (Yan Ming), a beautiful eunuch, is sent to investigate the corpse to calm the chaos. Enmei then notices Touka (Tao Hua), a maid who remains unperturbed about the presence of revenants and is instead dozing off. Though her features were as lovely as flowers, she possessed no ambitions nor a desire to be promoted; she was an unconcerned and lazy lady-in-waiting. Furthermore, it appeared unlikely that she would bend to Enmei who had at this point ensnared many ladies-in-waiting with his looks. The single thing that would awaken Touka was when a corpse was in front of her. She had knowledge of autopsies. A mystery set in the Chinese imperial harem where the numerous misgivings and mysteries inside the palace will be unraveled one after the other!

181034.description:
Due to her terminal illness, Princess Juliet has spent her entire life inside the Rozenta Kingdom's palace without any peers to talk to. So she's delighted to meet a kind young servant named Lete who provides her with much-needed company. However, their pleasant strolls end abruptly when Juliet is suddenly told to marry the archduke of Herventel, Enoch Letrachi. What comes as a greater shock is that Lete is actually Enoch, and that he has refused to see Juliet until she signs the marriage papers! Can Juliet find happiness when her trust in her husband-to-be has already been shattered?

(Source: Tappytoon)

181035.description:
One moment, world-famous celebrity Juliet Karenina is on top. Next, she wakes up in another world as Rubetria Diolus, a noble girl abused and cast aside by her own family. With Wisht, the Spirit of Wishes, she relives Rubetria’s memories and learns her step-grandmother spent years ruining her life to seize her house, name, and future. Now that she knows the truth, Juliet refuses to suffer in silence, and she’s ready to launch Rubetria into a dazzling new life as the empire’s brightest celebrity!

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: クンノミ〜百年分の勃起力を手に入れた男〜
อภินิหารสมุนไพรคืนชีพ

181037.description:
Sana, a Black Dragon rider, was about to cross the Skywall with her companions to attack the White Dragon. However, they were caught in a horrific baptism by fire, and she lost her companions right before her eyes. Sana was the only one to survive, and the traumatic experience left her unable to fly. Until she meets someone...

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Dragon rider still don't know the sky.

title.native: 竜使いはまだ空を知らない
title.romaji: Ryuu Tsukai wa Mada Sora wo Shiranai

181040.description:
The manga's story centers on Sera, a high school girl who easily gets into trouble. She gets a detestable new bodyguard who crushes people without hesitation.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 彼の世の獣が見る夢は
title.romaji: Ka no Yo no Kemono ga Miru Yume wa

181041.description:
An ordinary Japanese high school student takes home an abandoned supernatural cat left in a cardboard box. Maybe he shouldn't have meddled with kitties beyond human comprehension--after all, it had tentacles where its whiskers should have been! But it's too late!

With no Elder Sign on the cat door, soon the pick of the Mythos litter starts to invade his house, as furry and feline versions of Hastur, Yog-Sothoth, Nyarlathotep, and other adorable Lovecraftian horrors blast his mind, whisper impossible secrets, and generally get underfoot!

(Source: Dark Horse)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

181042.description:
Everyone is hiding a "secret."

Azuki Komugi is obsessed with ruminating on her memories of her high school girlfriend "Meguru," and creating a body model of hers out of clay. One day, Azuki drops her homemade "Meguru" at the 100-yen shop where she works part-time, and sneaks into her workplace on her off-shift to get "her" back. However, what she sees there is a fellow co-worker, high school girl Yoyuki Remu, who is about to express her lust for "Meguru" in a way that is different from Azuki's...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 僕らのアイは気持ち悪い
title.romaji: Bokura no Ai wa Kimochi Warui

181043.description:
A nerd Jin-U and a school star Chae-Yeong found out about each other's sex fantasy that could end their college life. Here's their fresh but unpredictable love story.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)
synonyms: 俺たちのラブコメはエロ漫画より激しく!?

title.english: Are you into that kind of thing?

title.native: 婚約破棄された可憐令嬢は、帝国の公爵騎士様に溺愛される
title.romaji: Konyaku Hakisareta Karen Reijou wa, Teikoku no Koushaku Kishi-sama ni Dekiaisareru

181045.description:
One is a girl who has a strange illusion that she died at sea; another is an athlete in the same year as her at school, who charms her with a look. Soon after, she falls into the water and is saved by her, and begins to want to start a friendship. Her best friend Suhasun suggests a plan to lend her a textbook. But Suhasun actually has an unhealthy crush on her, and wants to keep her by his side at any cost.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

181046.description:
Sojin and Jeongho have been friends for years, but she never knew he was keeping a secret…and a big one, at that. But when she hears talk around campus about how her best friend is packing quite the surprise, she just wants one little peek. Or two, or three…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.
synonyms: 触ってもいい？～イケメン幼なじみが血気盛ん過ぎて困る～
ขอจับหน่อยได้ไหม?

181047.description:
Today, as always, the girls have fun while practicing in a serious manner, as they bond with each other through table tennis!

This is an authentic school slice-of-life table tennis story!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

181049.description:
Asahi Sena, in her second year as a literary editor, is assigned to Zen Misaki, a writer she admires.
They hit it off immediately with their common interest in movies,
However, he is also a vampire who is cooperating with the police on cases involving supernatural entities…?
synonyms: Akogare no Sakka wa Ningen Ja Arimasen deshita

title.native: 憧れの作家は人間じゃありませんでした
title.romaji: Akogareno Sakka wa Ningen Jarimasen deshita

181051.description:
Yang-U Jo, a typical salaryman finds joy only when he plays gacha games. Unexpectedly, he downloads an app called Love Gotcha! as if he was tempted by “free rerolls”, he obtained his workplace junior Yun-Ha…?! He comes across the opportunity to scold her troublesome junior when…

“You have encountered your partner! Would you like to train her?”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

title.native: 魔物を狩るなと言われた最強ハンター、料理ギルドに転職する ～好待遇な上においしいものまで食べれて幸せです～
title.romaji: Mamono wo Karu na to Iwareta Saikyou Hunter, Ryouri Guild ni Tenshoku Suru: Kou Taigu na Ue ni Oishii Mono Made Taberete Shiawase desu

181054.description:
Kosaka Kotaro was living his best life as a gamer otaku…until the zombie apocalypse hit. Now the streets are crawling with the undead—and his biggest regret? Dying a virgin.

Then he rescues the gorgeous Kana, who’s just been bitten…and doesn’t want to turn into a zombie before losing her virginity. Kotaro’s happy to help—and after their steamy encounter, something incredible happens: her bite begins to fade.

Could the cure be inside Kotaro? Kana’s not taking any chances. She’s sticking close, keeping him busy—and making sure the “treatments” keep coming.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Zombie Sekai de Harem wo Tsukurou!

title.english: Let’s Make a Harem in a Zombie World!
title.native: ゾンビ世界でハーレムをつくろう！
title.romaji: Zombie World de Harem wo Tsukurou!

181056.description:
Meguru Shikayori is a mangaka who has fallen into a slump and lost faith in herself. Troubled, she gets into her car and drives from her hometown Kumamoto to Shimabara Port in Nagasaki. An encounter there changes her a little bit for the better....... Where would you like to go today?

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Where There Is Love There Is a Way

title.native: のら旅。～好きある所に道はある～
title.romaji: Nora Tabi. Suki Aru Tokoroni Michi wa Aru

181057.description:
The first-year high school boy Aoba diligently helps to take care of his younger siblings while their parents are busy at work. One day, they are invited over to play at the home of Mizutori, the beautiful girl in his class known as the "Ice Princess"…!?

(Source: Comic Trail, translated)
synonyms: The Ice Princess Wants to Be Melted by a Small Patch of Sunlight
After Helping the "Ice Princess" from Another School, I Decided to Start as a Friend.

title.native: 氷の姫は小さな陽だまりでとかされたい
title.romaji: Koori no Hime wa Chiisana Hidamari de Tokasaretai

181058.description:
Seo Eunsu was only looking for her lost cat when she was hit by a truck. The next thing she knows, she's in the body of Lewayne Rarsel, a villainess from a novel! She's the cruel paramour of the emperor and has nothing but contempt for therianthropes, people with animal forms. Now, the only way to avoid her fate of becoming the emperor's consort is to marry Duke Dimitri de Blua, a feline therian. But can the duke forget her notorious reputation and realize that Lewayne just wants to raise cats?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Even Though I Possessed a Villain, I Still Want to Raise a Cat
Even Though I Transmigrated as a Villainess, I'd Rather Raise a Cat
สิงร่างนางร้ายแล้วไง ก็ใจอยากเลี้ยงแมว

title.english: I Possessed a Villainess, but I Wanna Raise Cats!

181059.description:
Yeo Jooyeon has always been different. Ever since her school days, her unusually strong sexual desires pushed her to seek an unconventional career path by joining an adult toy company. For her, testing products firsthand and leaving real reviews isn’t just work… it’s pure pleasure. But amid her chaotic office life, she suddenly receives a shocking proposal from her team leader and secret crush, Lee Jungwoo:

“Jooyeon, how about becoming our model?”

(Source: Lezhin US)

181060.description:
Yeon-woo can’t help stumbling into pervy situations. What a creep would call a blessing is her curse. Case in point: going through an alley one night, she walks in on a couple making out. Except this time it’s worse—the couple is actually a vampire and her victim! The vampire, Hayang, is willing to let it slide… for some of Yeon-Woo’s blood! Could this be the start of a bloody good time?

(Source: Tapas)

181061.description:
Searching for motherly affection, I found myself with a mysterious sugar-mommy… The beginning of a twisted parent-child relationship between two people unrelated by blood but both starved for love.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Ainosenbiki: A Story of Getting a Mommy After Doing Sugar Mommy Dating

title.native: アイノセンビキ ～ママ活したらママができた話～
title.romaji: Ai no Senbiki: Mamakatsu Shitara Mama ga Dekita Hanashi

181062.description:
She just wants to start fresh so she can graduate in peace. She just wants to leave behind all the bad memories — her sleepwalking, the trauma from being bullied at school — all of it. She did everything she could to keep to herself, but the class president, Hae-On, just won't leave her alone. One day, when Seul-Bi visits the local lake Hae-On recommended, she comes across something she never imagined seeing in her wildest dreams: a wild, dark mermaid.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra.

181064.description:
A single mother who dislikes men finds herself falling for her neighbor, a younger man!? He's a bum and a playboy, but he's a great cook and he's good with kids. Isn't that exactly what she needs right now??

(Source: Ganma!, translated)
synonyms: When a Divorced Single Mother Met Her Love Swamp

title.native: 子連れバツイチ、最後の恋は沼でした。
title.romaji: Kozure Batsuichi, Saigo no Koi wa Numa deshita.

181066.description:
Liana Le Merdi, the last remaining pyromancer, hopes to avenge her family's murder by the great Alseid Hallias. At death's door, she is given a second chance at life by the fire god... as her three-year-old self? When she stands in front of Hallias again, instead of being killed, she ends up being adopted! She must now work with her enemy to uncover the truth behind her family’s death while escaping those who want to abuse her power. How will she survive when she can’t even pronounce her r’s?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Your Enemy in Your Past Life Was Your Father?

181069.description:
This world has been invaded by bugs.

With the appearance of the "Armored Bugs," mutating insect monsters that can overcome all modern weapons, humanity has been robbed of much of its living space. The only ones who can stand against such adversaries are the "Noble Butterflies," girls who harbor "Insects" that have gone through evolutions differing from the armored bugs.

One of the candidates to become a Noble Butterfly, Odamaki Ayumi, still suffers from the fact that she is unable to become one. Her best friend, who was supposed to be with her and was her object of admiration, has left her and no longer seeks her company.

Those days of despair came to an end when she was on the verge of death in a battle with armored bugs.
"Don't think that I... will die without doing anything!"

With the end near, the girl's body transformed into a butterfly one. And the flapping of her wings will bring about a revolution in the world...!

title.native: 蠱毒の胡蝶はどんな夢を見るのか？
title.romaji: Kodoku no Kochou wa Donna Yume wo Miru no ka?

181070.description:
A duke's daughter and the crown prince's fiancee... I, Rachel Sheringham, wielded dark attribute magic, which allowed me to use necromancy. I was accused of colluding with demons due to it and was executed. With regret as my source of power, I will return to life as a lich!!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: 「死霊術師など穢らわしい」と処刑されたので、魔族に転身致します
title.romaji: "Shiryoujutsushi nado Kegarawashii" to Shokei sareta node, Mazoku ni Tenshin Itashimasu

181071.description:
Claudia, the eldest daughter of the Rosenheim family, and Issac, the eldest son of the Lampertz family, are childhood friends who have been bickering ever since they were children. Whenever they see each other, they fight and argue… but they have skipped the “enemies to lovers” part of the story, and go directly to “engaged to marry” instead! It's because Claudia's magical powers are going out of control, but how will Issac help her…!?

(Source: 7iro Comics, translated)

181072.description:
"To all top players: This game is a real fantasy world. Reincarnate there, save the world, and I will grant any wish you desire."

Ayano, a former star voice actress, accepts the goddess's offer in hopes of shining once again as a voice actress. Reborn as a High Elf, one of the world's strongest races, she sets out on a quest to "clear" the game-like fantasy world using her player knowledge, joined by an irresistibly cute beast-eared heroine. But what awaits them beyond the game's scenario...!?

(Source: Kadokawa)

title.english: This Elf Will Not Be Shelved!
title.native: 捨てられエルフさんは世界で一番強くて可愛い！
title.romaji: Suterare Elf-san wa Sekai de Ichiban Tsuyokute Kawaii!

181073.description:
It has been a few decades or so since dungeons appeared on the earth and demons roamed around the world.

However, the era of adventurers as in the stories did not come, and many towns have been abandoned, the economy is in decline, and the world is full of lawless zones that are slowly heading toward extinction.

Amano Hobito, who has been training his own skills in the abandoned towns where death is the norm, and Shizuku, a mysterious beautiful girl with whom he shares a common destiny through the "Zanki" skill, challenge to save the world that coexists with dungeons using their unique skill, "Equivalent Exchange Store" as weapons...!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title.native: アースウィズダンジョン〜固有スキル≪等価交換ストア≫を駆使して世界救済を目指します〜
title.romaji: Earth with Dungeon: Koyuu Skill "Touka Koukan Store" wo Kushi Shite Sekai Kyuusai wo Mezashimasu

181074.description:
Having forced her husband, Alfonso, into a loveless marriage, Charlotte accepted when he sought solace from another woman. So when she wakes up in the past with a second chance, Charlotte hopes to sever ties while uniting him with his true love. To her dismay, however, any attempt to guide him away leads him right back to her! With Alfonso's gaze shifted to her, Charlotte is stuck between fixing her past regrets and shaping this new present into the future she had once hoped for with Alfonso.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Perfectly End a Contract Marriage

title.english: Ending This Marriage for Your Happiness

181075.description:
Born into privilege and raised like a princess, Oh Ro-Ji looks spoiled on the outside, but underneath the theatrics is someone painfully soft-hearted. To live a “normal” life, she’s spent years pretending to be the perfect girlfriend, forcing herself through a relationship that finally ends when her hopelessly bad-in-bed boyfriend pushes her past her limit. One night, Ro-Ji wanders into a women-only bar…and locks eyes with Lee Jin. Instant attraction. A spark she’s never felt before. And when Jin shows her what real desire feels like, Ro-Ji discovers a world of pleasure that she can only share with her.

(Source: Lezhin US)

181077.description:
Yui Nanjou has a "cute" figure and frame, and all of her attempts to look more mature at 28 have been futile. Everyone at her work place treats her like a small animal, and she's on the verge of giving up until meeting Mizuho, a kimono-clad beauty the same age. Taken away by her, she thinks to herself...

"If I wore kimono like she did... then maybe I'd look more like an adult..."

(Source: Renta!)

synonyms: I Can't Believe Having My Student Stolen from Me Turns Me On this Much

title.native: 教え子を寝取らせたらこんなに興奮するなんて
title.romaji: Oshiego wo Netorasetara Konna ni Koufun Suru Nante

181083.description: The middle aged male manager of a certain apartment complex quietly watches over the safe and secure lives of his tenants... and today, he will teach one such lively tenant who has lost her key ~various~ things.

title.native: わらべ団地のりおんちゃん

181084.description:
Nene Daikon is a 10-year-old girl who leads an ordinary but fun school life. One day, while thinking about her future dreams, she witnesses Takito Taki, a popular child actor, filming a drama in the neighborhood. Meeting him, Nene's destiny begins to move.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

181086.description:
1. Mite Mite Motto (みてみてもっと, Watch, Me Please! , Look Look More)

He seems to know about her unrequited love for him, and to make matters worse, he moves in with her family after running away from his hostile home environment. Can Eun-Seo cope with his sudden reappearance in her life? And is it possible that Si-Hwa loves her back?

There are legends of a nameless goblin swordsman. Missing one eye, with no mastery of magic, and born from a low-ranking tribe, yet he is well-spoken—and a warrior of peerless skill. With grace that matches his peerless swordplay, the tale of this wanderer from another world begins!

With her loyal owl companion Glyph at her side, she seeks out the forgotten spirits who once fought alongside her people, offering them one final chance to return to their realm. 181159.description:
Maeng Byeongtae has it all — a privileged background, a flawless physique, and more than enough where it counts. As a personal trainer, women were just passing distractions, good for relieving tension and nothing more. But everything changes when Seo Jihye walks into his gym. A new client. A married woman. The kind of trouble Byeongtae usually avoids without a second thought. And yet, something about Jihye — her quiet poise, the way loneliness clings to her — begins to shake his resolve.

(Source: Lezhin US)

181160.description:
In ten or so years, the moon will collide with the Earth, bringing with it the end of the world. Before the apocalypse happens, Nekuro confesses to her best friend Kiri. Kiri, seeing no hope for the future, takes her confession half-jokingly until one day, when Nekuro dies.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

181162.description:
Kaedetsuki, a high school student in the light music club, feels frustrated by his inability to fit in with his surroundings and his lack of clear goals. One day, while attending his favorite band's live performance for the first time, he meets his sister's friend, Asuka. While attending a vocational school to become a nursery school teacher, Asuka has been unable to give up on her once passionate pursuit of music. Kaedetsuki and Asuka feel suffocated by their suffocating daily lives. The two hit it off and start a band, but various obstacles stand in their way... Friends, family, adults, people they love.

People try to understand others. They want others to understand them. In the process, they discover a little bit of themselves they can like.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: テレキャスタービーボーイ

181163.description:
One day, completely against his will, Kim Namju finds himself hexed by a sparkly fairy named Seobi—and just like that, he becomes the unwilling mascot of a team of magical girls. Their mission? To defeat the Demons of Desire, monsters born from the collective lust of humanity, who are now plotting to take over Earth. So far, so weird—but then comes the kicker. To truly purify these lust-fueled demons, Namju has to help the magical girls and monsters fulfill their wildest desires. Yes, all of them. Cue awkward moans, questionable missions, and Namju screaming,

“This is NOT what I signed up for!”

Now stuck between sparkles and sin, Namju must somehow save the world, preserve his sanity, and—if possible—not die of embarrassment. Saving Earth has never been this extra.

(Source: Lezhin US)

On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Sorano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see.
Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side

(Source: Yen Press)

181170.description:
Sachiya, an ordinary salaryman, moves into an apartment where, for some reason, all his neighbors are married women whose husbands are away for work, such that Sachiya is the only man in the complex. They naturally start asking Sachiya to help them with the chores that need a man's strength, and in return they offer him plenty of home-cooked meals and other thoughtful gifts. Until one day, when his neighbor Nonoka discovers that Sachiya has a strong libido who needs to get off several times a day. Since then, the lonely and sexually frustrated women in the complex start asking Sachiya for a different sort of help…

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

The fox groom fell in love with Kei, and Rito was betrothed to the fox. From that night on, Rito also gained the ability to see supernatural phenomena...!? A story of a broken engagement between a boy betrothed to a fox and a boy who wants to cure his ability to see supernatural phenomena!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Fox's Fiance Sneers and Laughs

She calls herself an ice cream spirit, and she promises to make his wish come true... if he hugs her tightly first! But when they get too close, this ice cream spirit might melt…!

181177.description:
When middle schooler Kaoru Tachibana runs away from home in the pouring rain, the last person she expects to bump into is her homeroom teacher, Mirei Shimotsuki. When Mirei takes her in for a few days, Kaoru is surprised to learn that the same woman who’s normally so put together is actually a disorganized, laid-back day drinker behind closed doors. On the other hand, she’s the only one who accepts Kaoru, struggles and all, and it’s captivating. But with Mirei keeping her distance emotionally, what will become of their unusual relationship...?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Summer Love Begins with a Lie -squall-

title.english: Summer Love Begins with a Lie -squall-
title.romaji: Uso kara Hajimaru Koi no Natsu: squall

title.native: スパイシーミルクキャンディ 泉澄くん縛られ編

181183.description:
"If a dog walks, he gets a stick." As the lines from Iroha Garuta go.
Detective Gondo's nickname is "Inu-bo" (Dog Stick) as he walks around investigating. Toto Bank was robbed by three robbers, but the main suspect, who was waiting in a car, shot and killed the three robbers and fled.
Inu-bo's investigation begins.
synonyms: 東京捜査戦線 犬棒

title.native: 東京捜査戦線 いぬ棒

181184.description:
In April 1926, the young Dr. Asahina, who was taking aerial photographs deep in the Greater Amazon region of South America, photographed a man-made fence on a cliff.

Earlier, primitive people were discovered in a village near the entrance to the unexplored Chablo. An investigation team including Dr. Asahina is formed, and Kazumasa heads for the unexplored Chablo, but what does he encounter there?

A Jidai Gekiga "Nozarashi Narugen" and 4 other stories are included in this collection.

181185.description:
A man and a woman are on their way to Hong Kong to sell stolen jewelry to the local syndicate. Sekine gets on the same plane to intercept them. What awaits Sekine and the woman after they kill the man, get the jewelry, the woman, and get the drugs from the boss of the organization?

Note: This is a collection of short action stories by Takao Saito under the title "Gorilla Collection: Don't Tell Me to Stop!" and 10 other stories.
synonyms: The Wolf Washes His Fangs with Blood

title.romaji: Ookami wa Kiba wo Chi de Arau

181186.description:
Adaptation of the classic Chinese novel by the same name.

The story, set in the Song dynasty, tells of how a group of 108 outlaws gathers at Mount Liang (or Liangshan Marsh) to form a sizable army before they are eventually granted amnesty by the government and sent on campaigns to resist foreign invaders and suppress rebel forces. It has introduced to readers many of the most well known characters in Chinese literature, such as Wu Song, Lin Chong and Lu Zhishen.

181187.description:
Mako, a clothing store clerk, has always been popular with other women for her coolness. What she’s hiding from her girlfriend however is that she actually wants to be doted on, but tries not to destroy her image.

(Source: MAG Garden, translated)

1-4. Toko-sen (とこセン)

181191.description:
In 1942, as the war on the Eastern Front intensified, the normal life of Serafima, a young girl living in a rural village near Moscow, is suddenly shattered. An assault by the German forces massacred the villagers, including her mother. Just as Serafima is about to be shot, she is rescued by Irina, a female soldier of the Red Army. Determined to defeat the enemies who killed her family, Serafima, along with her comrades, undergoes rigorous training to become snipers.

(Source: HayaComic Web, translated)

title.romaji: Doushi Shoujo yo, Teki wo Ute

181192.description:
"The holy water is basically pee, right...?!"

Suzuna stopped going to school because she hated having to pee there, and with the help of her sister, a manga artist, she has been working as her assistant instead. One day, after one too many all-nighters, she misstepped on the stairs and fell… She thought she was dead, but she was instead reincarnated as the saintess in her sister's serialized manga Seijo no Oseisui ga Banouyaku de Isekai Musou (The Saint's Holy Water Is the Source of Isekai Power)!

The story of unrivaled peeing in another world begins!

(Source: Comic Gamma Plus, translated)

title.native: 聖水革命 ～おもらし聖女はその聖水で無双する～
title.romaji: Seisui Kakumei: Omorashi Seijo wa Sono Seisui de Musou suru

181193.description:
Our Protagonist was an avid gamer, obsessed with a fantasy game with multiple outcomes for its Female Lead. After meeting her untimely demise, she was reborn into the game as Remilian, the daughter of the Female Lead.

Her extensive knowledge of the game was no longer any good, as she was born after the game's worst ending had already occurred. Now stuck with a tragic story, unable to change anything following the ""Bad Ending"", she is content with her small but happy life with her loving mother, the original Female Lead, even though they are imprisoned by the King, Remilian's actual father. Following an attempt at escape, Remilian finds herself on the brink of dying again, but a last moment spell from her mother throws her back into the past.

Waking up in a timeline before the game's events have unfolded, Remilian now has all the knowledge she needs to make a choice: Will she change her mother's tragic ending, even at the cost of never being born?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: The Female Lead's Daughter After the Ending
ลูกคนนี้ขอเปลี่ยนตอนจบ

title.romaji: Heroine no Musume wa Bad End wo Kutsugae Shitai

181194.description:
I hate going to the office in the morning, and having to commute on a crowded train makes it even worse! What if you could relieve the morning blues, even if only a little? This is an encounter with a sunny gal, for all the working stiffs who feel like they are stuck on their morning commute!

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)
synonyms: The High School Girl Who Randomly Talks to Me on the Morning Commuter Train.

title.native: 朝の通勤電車で、やたらと話しかけてくる女子高生。
title.romaji: Asa no Tsuukin Densha de, Yatara to Hanashikaketekuru Joshikousei.

181195.description:
Despite the nine-year age difference between Koki and Kisa, the two get along surprisingly well. After receiving pressure from both of their mothers, they make a spur-of-the-moment decision to get married (without telling their moms that they've never even dated). The idea of them growing into their marriage sounds rather romantic... but the marriage is actually more like a contract! Kisa's never had a boyfriend and Koki's a total player. Will their marriage work out!?

(Source: B-comi)

title.english: We Got Married Without Even Dating. So, What?
title.romaji: Kousai 0-nichi Kon desu ga Nani ka?

181196.description:
In a world where a special fossil fuel known as Meteorian coal has become the number one source of fuel, steam engines have taken the world by storm. Kanata, a young coal miner, diligently studies despite his dire circumstances. One day, while breaking into a new vein of ore, Kanata finds the gears of fate have begun to turn for him—as he learns the monstrous secret of Meteoria!

(Source: Yen Press)

181197.description:
Six years ago, novelist Jung Seon lost everything, including his young son and his marriage. To escape the grief, he moves to a quiet rural village for a teaching gig, where he forms an unexpected, deep bond with an orphan named Hyeon-Wu. Just as they grow inseparable, Hyeon-Wu vanishes without a word on the eve of his adulthood. Two years later, he suddenly reappears as a charismatic stage actor, ready to script a new, intense chapter in their lives.

(Source: Lezhin US)

181200.description: Getting influenced by an old anime "Rabbit Portrait", Usapo has sworn to be a strong and lovely girl! She rises up to save all the troubled girls who have lost their place of belonging! In a "game" that unfolds in extreme conditions, the true nature of human will be revealed! This is a dark and cute battle between the troubled kids!

やさしい?メスガキサキュバス～ヤンキーおしおき編～

title.romaji: NO.1 Succudol-chan wa Oshinobi Sakusei Shitai!!

181204.description:
A conspiracy led by a selected few, freed from the hands of death after being infected by the vampire syndrome. After successfully establishing their world secretly, they became the most powerful entities by having control not only of the police but also of politics and the media. People who knew of their existence called them “The Afters”. Meanwhile, Tae-Su Dan, who had lost everything due to them, forms a strong team for his revenge. Having established his team, Tae-Su heads to “Red table”, a prison camp for bloodbags, to rescue Dam Yi, the bloodbag with the best blood on Earth. How will Tae-Su Dan carry out his revenge? And will he and his friends succeed?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes a prologue

181215.description:
Struggling to survive in a stressful society, office worker Kuuko's only way to relieve stress is to cook, eat, and sleep! On weekend nights, she blows away her stress with an immoral high-calorie meal!

This heartwarming new food manga about a marginal office worker's stress-busting life begins!

synonyms: キージャック デッドロック

181217.description:
Se-Him’s field trip to Banhyang Island takes an ominous turn when a fierce storm leaves everyone stranded. As three students inexplicably vanish amidst the storm, Se-Him and his friends scramble to find out why. But, their desperate efforts only seem to drag them deeper into the island’s sinister secrets— every revelation intensifying the chilling forces lurking on the island, their chances of leaving the island seem uncertain by the day.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

181218.description:
1-3, 5. Tensei Shinakutemo Kami Appli de Jinsei Ippatsu Gyakuten Dekita Kudan (転生しなくても神アプリで人生一発逆転できた件); COMIC MILF 2023-06, 10, 2024-04
4. Dousoukai Nante Ikanakereba Yokatta (同窓会なんて行かなければ良かった); COMIC MILF 2023-02

181220.description:
Staying alive is a new form of entertainment.

When Do-Kyung, disillusioned by the harshness of life, finally resolves to call it quits, a bored demon, Hwamyung, appears before her with a particular offer. Will Do-Kyung, having entered into a contract with the Demon of Disillusionment, be able to flip her disastrous life upside down?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: สัญญาใจนายปีศาจ

181221.description:
Haemu Kang is in crisis mode after his recent breakup. To ensure he’s okay, his friends and former classmates rally together and take turns keeping him company. But hangouts quickly turn into something more, and Haemu finds the ultimate distraction: steamy encounters with guys leagues cooler than his ex. But will this mess up his chances with the one that got away? Haemu will find out when his secret crush shows up unexpectedly on his doorstep.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes two side story chapters.

title.native: 異世界商人 スキル＜異世界渡航＞を駆使して、悠々自適なお金持ちスローライフを送ります

181226.description:
For Yu Suzukaze, reuniting with the childhood friend he adored feels like a dream come true. After ten long years apart, they can finally enjoy high school life together. But it turns out, this girl isn’t exactly "single"!

(Source: Manga UP!)

181229.description:
Life on spin cycle, or hung out to dry?

Sang-A's life becomes a living hell after meeting the mysterious Ya-Cheon, who places a curse on her. She quits her job and returns to her hometown where she discovers a dry cleaner run by Cheong-Myeong, to whom her destiny is tied. The two must unravel their red thread of fate and save Sang-A's soul.

(Source: Manta, edited)

title.native: 下町のエピキュリアン
執事くんの寸止めミルクティー カウパー多め
title.romaji: Shitsuji-kun no Tsudome Milk Tea Cowper Oome

title.native: 怪物少女図鑑 〜出逢い、バカ。編〜
title.romaji: Kaibutsu Shoujo Zukan: Deai, Baka. Hen

181236.description:
Togawa Hinata, a small boy attending Kirimori Academy, an all-boys boarding school, lives in the old dormitory, Asunaro Hall, which has only six residents. Takamiya Echika, a tall transfer student who arrived at the start of the new semester, moves in as Usagawa's roommate. Usagawa is excited about this new encounter, but Takamiya speaks to him bluntly, and the two are at odds with each other from the very first day. Even as they argue, Usagawa realizes that Takamiya has the insight of a detective in a TV drama... A youthful school mystery unfolds as the mismatched roommates take on the mystery of a murder case.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Solving the Riddle With My Roommate

title.native: ルームメイトと謎解きを

181237.description:
High school student Kaneto reunites with his childhood friend Kosuke, who he cut ties with, for the first time in a long time. While trying to save a cat that was about to fall into the river, he ends up falling into the river with Kosuke. When he wakes up, he finds himself in an unfamiliar place. He tries to find his way home, but Kosuke seems to be acting strangely... Furthermore, they are attacked by a group dressed in unfamiliar clothing and Kosuke is taken away, and the two are separated...

A Chinese fantasy where you search for your childhood friend and uncover secrets from the past in a mysterious place that somehow feels nostalgic, despite being another world!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

181239.description:
"I'm in a situation I longed for, but what should I do?!"

Honjo Yuu is achieving decent results at work, but harbors complexes about romance. One day, she wonders if her inability to marry is due to her obsession with 2D. She impulsively deletes a novel she'd written in the past. When she wakes up the next morning, a 2D character she had a crush on in middle school has appeared! It seems the character lost his place in the world after deleting the novel, and now he's appeared!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: Wake Me Up If It's a Dream

181240.description:
Takuma Kuze lost his life in a freak accident on Christmas Day. However, he was reincarnated, in his original form, by the god of another world, Alvaresia. The mission that God gave him was not to defeat the demon king or rebuild the new world, but to find himself a wife in Alvaresia, where polygamy is allowed!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)
synonyms: Isekai de Kuchizuke wo! Tensei Sekai wa Unmei no Hito de Michiteiru
異世界でくちづけを！ 転生世界は運命の人で満ちている

title.native: キスからはじまる異世界ハーレム　～一夫多妻の世界に転生したので神が決めた運命の人を探します～
title.romaji: Kiss kara Hajimaru Isekai Harem: Ipputasai no Sekai ni Tensei Shita node Kami ga Kimeta Unmei no Hito wo Sagashimasu

181243.description: Eienko, with golden hair and blue eyes, is called "the devil's child" by the villagers and is hated by them. She lives a strong life, aiming to repay her beloved grandmother, her only ally... but one day, she suddenly finds herself in a world of demons! In order to return home, she must marry the god of death who rules the world...? A Japanese-style Cinderella fantasy about the strongest Shinigami and his contract bride!
synonyms: The Grim Reaper and His Wife
The Grim Reaper and His Bride

title.native: 復讐のゴブリン ～異世界からの断罪者～
title.romaji: Fukushou no Goblin: Isekai kara no Danzaisha

181246.description:
In the coal mining town crowded with small-scale miners, known as the "Hakoniwa", there is a girl named Kagari who runs a map shop, and her childhood friend Yuya, who dreams of breaking free from the "Hakoniwa" and the ever-changing labyrinth-like tow. Lately, suspicious "sinkhole accidents" occurring frequently in the town begin to encroach on their daily lives. Will Kagari be able to overcome this situation and determine the fate of the town? Beyond the challenges, the girl will grow up a bit today.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

181247.description:
Kakeru Endo, a farmer from Hokkaido, is suddenly transported to another world while taking a bath!!!

Here, magical beast milk is a powerful energy source used for everything from everyday tools to weapons. The warriors who collect it are known as "Milk Hunters," but their dwindling numbers have caused a severe milk shortage across the kingdoms. Summoned to save the world from its milk crisis, Kakeru becomes a Milk Hunter.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title.english: A Milking Hunter's Otherworldly Milk-Harvesting Journal
title.native: ミルク搾りハンターの異世界搾乳記～農家の冴えない男があらゆる種族の地区Bを弄び虜にする～
title.romaji: Milk-shibori Hunter no Isekai Sakunyuuki: Nouka no Saenai Otoko ga Arayuru Shuzoku no Chiku-B wo Moteasobi-toriko ni Suru

181248.description:
After spending the night playing the latest 18+ game, Itsuki Kusaka finds himself waking up in an entirely different world! Despite the fact he has no desire to be a hero, his attitude changes when a giant, naked goddess tells him the details of his mission. All Itsuki has to do is teach her disciples a thing or two about sex. With hands-on learning, of course.

Is this a dream come true for this adult gaming fan, or will Itsuki find his mission to be more challenging than he expected?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Doing Secret Things with the Holy Maidens

title.english: Secret Rites with the Holy Maidens
title.native: 聖なる乙女と秘めごとを

181249.description:
For a long time, the Demon King was hailed as the “strongest”. After defeating countless heroes who challenged him, he eventually grew tired of his life and drove a sword into his own heart. But when he came to, he had been reincarnated as a human baby in a world 1,000 years later...! Reborn as Zeon, the former Demon King enjoys a peaceful life as a human farmer. But by a twist of fate, he ends up being recognized as the hero of this generation?! The tale of a reincarnated Demon King dominating the world as a hero!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: This Brave Man Is a Former Demon King.

title.native: この勇者、元魔王につき
title.romaji: Kono Yuusha, Moto Maou ni Tsuki

title.native: 最弱種族の俺が魔王ガチャで引かれる確率
title.romaji: Saijaku Shuzoku no Ore ga Maou Gacha de Hikareru Kakuritsu

181251.description:
My crush is telling me the thing I least wanted to hear, how did I end up like this!?

Note: Originally published in Margaret 2024 issue No. 15.

title.native: どうか嘘だと言ってくれ！

181253.description:
Magical coal has revolutionized travel in the 19th century British Empire. Now trains and boats are hardly the only way to get around—not when you could catch a ride on a pipe! Like a witch's broomstick, these sleek iron contraptions have taken the nation by storm…and made Sheena late for work again. It's not her fault! Those dumb rich kids keep closing off the streets to race their fancy-schmancy pipes. It's so stupid! But after getting in an accident and challenging a stuck-up rich girl, Sheena may just find her true calling lies in the high-speed world of pipe racing!

(Source: Yen Press)

181256.description:
The common front of two mysterious people begins! It is said that those who possess the mysterious relic, the “Double”, will gain great wealth. Chloe, a bounty hunter with the “Double,” continues her journey for a certain purpose. Once she meets a mysterious girl, Hal, they decide to work together, but...

(Originally published in Aokishi)

181257.description: Note: Chapter count includes the epilogue and 1 omake.

title.romaji: Isekai-dou no Mia: Omochikaeri wa Ajin Maid desu ka?

181259.description:
Many years have passed since the Great Shameless War. Somehow, to our delight, Shameless School is back in the 21st century! This time the Shameless School is learning the ways of golf. And so begins golf games where no shame is found. In the games, many nostalgic faces participate from works such as Abashiri Family, Kekkou Kamen, and even Devilman. Who gets the ball in the hole? Sure enough, Jubei is a strong hitter like always~ This is the Second Coming of the Shameless School that everyone has been waiting for~!

The volume also includes Pink's Green, 2 special golf-themed chapters originally released in 1985.

181260.description:
Yamagishi and Fukurokoji, fresh from university, are starting as the first male teachers in the prestigious girls' Harenochi school. Sure enough, like the predecessor Harenchi Gakuen, the school isn't lacking in perverted teachers and students.

Heisei Harenchi Gakuen was first released in volume form when it was included in the 6 volume reissue of Harenchi Gakuen by Koike Shoin in 2007, and was later released as a standalone ebook.

The series was included in the Italian release of Harenchi Gakuen by Edizioni BD under the J-POP imprint in 2016.

181262.description:
Growing up deep in the forest, Misha is a thirteen-year-old girl learning how to craft medicine from nature's bounty, but she's also picked up a tremendous amount of knowledge from her mother, an estranged member of a distant tribe of remarkably skilled apothecaries. When tragedy draws the pair out of their forest home, Misha finds herself confronted with a grim truth: all the knowledge in the world is of no help if she doesn't have the experience to put it to use. Faced with her own inadequacy, the young girl resolves to learn how to put her gifts to use properly. Her world is about to expand far beyond the forest she once called home.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

181271.description:
Ichitaro Ushiro confronted various paranormal phenomena under the supervision of his father Kentaro, a researcher in psychic science. Sometimes his life was threatened, but he was protected by Hyakutaro, Ichitaro's guardian spirit. He also unraveled paranormal mysteries with the help of his psychic dog Zero, who had a human face and can communicate with him telepathically.

This edition compiles the most impactful stories from the series into one 876 page volume to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Weekly Shonen Magazine.

181272.description:
Dare to read the psycho-horror classic that horror manga master Ito Junji called a “frightening but moving story about an unfortunate individual who, lost in search of his true self, finds his own annihilation instead.”

Little Tetsuo is a wimpy mess. His parents don’t love him. He meets the beautiful Kimiko, an ailing teenage girl obsessed with movies and mayhem in equal amounts. She doesn’t love Tetsuo either, or anyone other than herself. But she needs him. So Tetsuo becomes the man she wants—the monster she wants. He becomes HER FRANKENSTEIN!

Originally published in 1986, Kawashima Norikazu’s HER FRANKENSTEIN marks the bizarre and sadomasochistic finale to a cult era in Japanese horror comics. A few years after it was published, the author burned all of his artwork and abandoned Tokyo, never to be heard from again!

(Source: Living The Line)

181278.description:
This science fiction human drama is centered on an alien living in Ikebukuro, assigned to explore the Earth. Unable to understand its people, whose only concerns are “money” and “sex,” the alien is on the verge of losing his confidence as a member of a xenoprobe team when one day he meets a man who calls himself “Honda,” an Earth name. The alien begins to respect Honda, who guides him around town as a “space senior"...

(Source: Natalie, tranlated)

Published in the Comic Beam in the late 90s, it was releassed in tankoubon format 20 years laters in 2018.

181287.description:
How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Tae-Sun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Tae-Sun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Tae-Sun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Tae-Sun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being’s seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.
synonyms: La seducción de la serpiente sagrada

181288.description:
Just because Naui’s next-door neighbor is tall, tattooed, and sexy as hell doesn’t give him the right to be loud all night! Naui can’t get any sleep because of the moaning and humping going on next door, and he can’t seem to confront his horny neighbor either. Will Naui ever get any rest, or will he find himself up all night in his neighbor’s bed instead?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title.english: Muhyeok and Naui: My Irresistible Neighbor

181289.description:
In a world where peoples' names grant them superhuman powers... Two agents from the Nordic Naming Bureau(NNB), an agency specialized in investigating crimes committed by "Namers", handle the case of a man and his missing wife and son.

Things take a turn, however, when the duo come face to face with the man, who wishes to give his son the same name as himself...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

181291.description:
Choi Ji-Hu works as secretary to Jung Da-Won, the CEO of Seungjin Corporation. On the surface, he seems like just another ordinary employee, but he’s hiding a dangerous secret - he’s received an offer promising an enormous sum of money in exchange for a damning video that could jeopardize Da-Won’s inheritance of the company. Hoping to make a big break, Ji-Hu carefully collects evidence in secret. But one day, he gets caught…by Da-Won himself! However, instead of reacting with anger, Da-Won jumps to an unpredictable conclusion: “Secretary Choi, do you love me?" Panicked, Ji-Hu blurts out a response without thinking: “Yes! I love you!” Having fallen head-over-heels for his secretary, Da-Won is about to show Ji-Hu what it means to be loved until you’re dog-tired!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.
synonyms: ขนหมาสื่อรัก

181292.description:
Japan has been devastated by attacks from giant monsters! Tanks, bombs, missiles, airpower—all are useless against the overwhelming threat. In a desperate gambit, ace pilot Yamato Shidou is placed on board a giant biological weapon, code name: Kamuy. The only thing that can beat a kaiju…is another kaiju!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

181293.description:
Kyu-Ha’s been hopelessly crushing on Woo-Hyun ever since their freshman orientation. But at a drinking party, he hears a devastating rumor: queen bee Hye-Jin got to him first! Heartbroken and drunk out of his mind, Kyu-Ha stumbles home, slips into a lacy maid outfit and racy lingerie, and takes some very questionable photos. He then sends some explicit messages to Woo-Hyun via what he thinks is an anonymous burner account - only to wake up the next morning to see it was his real account after all! But Woo-Hyun doesn’t seem to mind…in fact, he seems more than happy to take Kyu-Ha up on his offer!

(Source: Lezhin US)

181294.description:
Selene Vixent has died nine times. Each time, she’s betrayed and dumped by her fiancé, is abused by her noble family, and meets an untimely end—all because she doesn't awaken to the power of Sun, the so-called power of protection inherited by those in her family. Selene is determined to escape this cursed time loop, and after nine deaths, she abandons all attempts to be the perfect fiancée and daughter. She instead awakens to the power of Shadow—seen to be an ominous portent of misfortune—and fully embraces her new life as a villainess. However, everything changes when Dier Veldt, the former crown prince of the kingdom of Werkst, tells Selene he knows all about her time loops. He offers to help her under one condition: she kills him. With her newfound villainous ways, can Selene break free of these endless time loops once and for all?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: During serialization, all chapters were split into two parts, later combined in the volume release.

title.english: Stuck in a Time Loop: When All Else Fails, Be a Villainess

181295.description:
The development of the large robot "Walker" has ushered in a lawless age of endless conflict. Following his grandfather's will, a young boy named Jean searches for "Blue," a man who holds the secrets of his family. One day, he is saved by a mercenary with beautiful blue hair, who is oppressed as a low-ranking member of a band of thieves. By chance, the man ends up working with Jean, calling himself "Blue," but... A robot action movie set in the midst of war that depicts the lives and troubles of mercenaries!!

(Source: Scroll Book, translated)

181296.description:
“When the apocalypse comes, the world will be ridden with bloodshed and screams of anguish. In the end, none but ashes will remain.”

He has been locked up in an underground prison his whole life. He does not know his name. He does not know when the world will end, nor if the world really even will end. The only thing he knows is that he has been imprisoned... by his own father.

(Source: WEBTOON)

181298.description: Collection of short stories, in part sequel to the original Madara series, in part 'spin-off' with character reincarnations in a modern setting. The spin-off story was later completed in a novel titled "Boku wa Tenshi no Hane wo Humanai" (僕は天使の羽根を踏まない).

181299.description:
This story depicts the battle between Basara, a boy who has a demon inside his body, and Koga Saburo, who tries to guide Basara due to the karma from his previous life.

Note: This is one of the sequels to the fantasy series "Mouryou Senki Madara," in which the characters fight over 108 reincarnations. Almost all of the characters are reincarnations of characters from "Mouryou Senki Madara," or beings with the same motifs.
When it was first released, it was referred to as the "second part" of the main series, volumes 5 to 7, and was titled "Mouryou Senki Madara Madara 2" ("Madara 2" was treated as a subtitle). Later, due to Tajima Shouu's desire to separate it from the main series when it was republished, it was renamed "Mouryou Senki Madara BASARA."

181300.description:
A life-changing death game where you lie about your name, lie about your gender, follow lies and instincts, and risk your life and money.. A full-fledged spin-off depicting the unknown deadly battle of the participants who advanced to the main battle is now starting!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

181304.description:
Ecto, the third son of the Margrave of Glenreed, received the skill of Earth Magic during his coming-of-age ceremony. However, Earth Magic—unsuited for combat—is considered a so-called "dud attribute." As a result, he was disowned and appointed as the lord of the remote and desolate Border Village. But thanks to a certain secret, Ecto had come up with ingenious ways to use Earth Magic that ordinary people would never imagine! Together with his companions—including the female adventurer party Wings of Attack, who serve as his guards—he defeats magical beasts, clears forests, cultivates farmland... Thanks to Earth Magic, Border Village begins to undergo a remarkable transformation!

(Source: Alpha Manga)
synonyms: I Was Banished to a Desolate Region Because of the Faulty Attribute Earth Magic, so I'm Going to Put in My All to Develop My Territory!

181306.description:
The mysterious creatures that suddenly appeared are… Moimon. A charming exterior, balanced against an inherent savagery and tough bodies. At first glance, it appeared that humanity had finally established a master-servant relationship with them through training… But as a new found ferocity spreads through wild Moimon, the continued survival of the human race is in question.

Kakeru is a boy from a warrior tribe that survives by hunting Moimon. Shimizu is a girl dreaming of adventure. Together, they set off to gather clues to stop the ferocious mutation of these creatures. And so rises the curtain on a new and exciting monster battle action series featuring bizarre creatures called Moimon and the boy who hunts them!

(Source: Manga UP!)

181308.description:
Rokuto Fuyuki used to be feared as a demon detective by the evil people. Now he is a pacifier who pays off the evil people.

Oroku, who came to Hokkaido in pursuit of a man and a woman who absconded from the syndicate with a sum of money of 5,000,000 yen, was confronted by a woman from Oroku's past.

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

Note: The book contains five stories in the "Oroku Series" and two other works.

181310.description:
When a UFO from the Vega Alliance arrives on Earth, humanity faces its biggest threat in an oncoming Alien invasion. But their hope arrives in another Alien, Duke Fleed, a refugee of the planet Fleed who finds his home in Japan. Duke pilots the mighty Grendizer, a weaponized Mech to fight off the Vega forces. Along with his best friend and partner Koji Kabuto, they fight to free Earth from the terror of the Vega forces.

(Source: Titan Manga)

Note:The story of "The Inception" opens with a prequel that is not told in the TV anime.

181313.description:
"My name is Song Gi-Tae. I’m 20 years old. That’s all I remember."

Gi-Tae wakes up in a windowless room, with no memory of how he got there—only the steady rhythm of three meals a day delivered by the ever-gentle Cha Ji-Hun to hint at the passage of time. No matter how cold or cutting Gi-Tae becomes, Ji-Hun only responds with warm smiles and tender concern. But trust is a luxury Gi-Tae can’t afford. Not when the man bringing him food…is the same one who cut off his foot.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Masahiro and Kyouko are two childhood friends who meet again at university. After a disastrous date, Masahiro discovers that at the train station he is being chased by a girl who keeps calling him "daddy".
2. Ore wa Otoko da! (おれは男だ!) - Weekly Shounen Jump Special Issue #8, 1980
Tsukasa Hojo's debut work. Shou is the representative of the students of an all-boys high school, a faithful follower of tradition and with great animosity towards the female sex. Iwasaki is the representative of St. Carolina Academy, open-minded and progressive. What will happen if the two are forced to live together?
3. Neko-manma Okawari (ネコまんまおかわり♡) - Weekly Shounen Jump #34, 1986
A Parody of "Tsuru no Ongaeshi" (鶴の恩返し) with a cat as a main character. Yuuichi is a photographer who makes a living by taking scandalous photos of celebrities. One day, while photographing a couple in a hotel, he saves the life of a white cat. That's how he meets Miku, the owner, a young woman with whom he begins to spend a lot of time, but never beyond midnight....

A prequel/pilot to the series Komorebi no Moto de.
7. Family Plot (ファミリー・プロット ) - Weekly Shounen Jump #11, 1992
Losing your memory is not only painful for themselves, but also for people who love you. Hideyuki, a photographer, tries to find the memories that bind him to his son and the woman he loved. Pilot of Family Compo.
8. Taxi Driver - Weekly Shounen Jump #6, 1990
A story about a vampire who works as a night taxi driver. His victims are his clients…or so it should be, for his good heart often remains with dry mouth, and when a young girl asks for his help, the real trouble begins.
9. Shoujo no Kisetsu - Summer Dream (少女の季節 -サマー ドリーム- ) - Weekly Shounen Jump #39, 1992
Misako was always afraid of water, a distant memory that resurfaces in her dreams, until she finds herself trapped in a strange realm, somewhere between her dream and her past….

Volume 3:The Summer the Boys Were There: Melody of Jenny (少年たちのいた夏~Melody of Jenny~) [Story by Shingo Nihashi] [1996-2]

11. Shounentachi no Ita Natsu ~Melody of Jenny~ (少年たちのいた夏 〜Melody of Jenny〜 ) - Weekly Shounen Jump #28-29, 1995
A group of kids in an encampment, set up by the Japanese government during WWII to house and school children, escape in hopes of returning to their families in Tokyo. Along the way, they meet an American who has been living in Japan for the past ten years and agree to travel together, but...
12. American Dream - Weekly Shounen Jump #36-37, 1995
In 1935 in San Francisco, the San Francisco Stars hosted a series of baseball exhibition games with a Japanese baseball team. Amid the increasingly racially tense atmosphere of that time period, ace pitcher Murakawa meets Johnny, an American scout, and Yuu, a Japanese girl living in the States. Amazed by his skills, Johnny asks Murakawa if he wants to pursue the American dream...
