The Time of Cherry Blossoms As The Sakura Petals Bloom
The Summer the Boys Were There ~Melody of Jenny~
Shounen Tachi no Ita Natsu ~Melody of Jenny~
Shounen-tachi no Ita Natsu: Melody of Jenny

181315.description:
Eun Pyo-Eum, the leader of the failed idol group Moses, is desperate for a comeback. When a mysterious sponsorship deal offers him a lifeline, there’s just one problem: he has chronic erectile dysfunction. Seeking help from the nation's top urologist, Professor Han Girip, Pyo-Eum finds that standard medicine won't cut it. To fix his condition, he agrees to participate in Girip’s new experimental therapy...a treatment that quickly turns into a series of (quite literally) shocking encounters.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Rapport sur la reddition de la prostate

181317.description:
A girl who has been alone her whole life stumbles upon a VR fantasy dating simulator that allows her to be who she always wanted to be — someone loved by everyone. She chooses a character named Crocetta Gaetani, who grew up neglected by others just like her. Now she’s stuck permanently in the video game world until she can win over one of the game’s male leads and beat the game. Will Crocetta be able to marry one of the male leads and finally return to her reality, or will she be stuck in this VR nightmare forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: เกมรักจับสามี

181318.description:
1-2. Yumeiro no Tsumikibako (夢色の積み木箱)
A two-part one-shot concerning Chiyoko (Choco), an up-and-coming animator, and her trials and tribulations in love and growing up.
2. Natsu Monogatari (夏物語)
The bittersweet story of two volleyball-playing sisters who are in love with their coach.
3. Yasashisa Tazunete (やさしさたずねて)
Yuko has a faint memory from when she was younger of meeting a certain boy. One day, a boy who resembles him happens to transfer into her school...!?

181319.description:
In the dark corners of a 1920s city where wealth and poverty, dreams and despair all coalesce, a boy named Sangha lives humbly with his beloved little sister. Their fragile happiness is soon shattered by the iron fist of the mafia that rules over the city. Sangha is left broken, sinking into the depths of despair, until someone reaches out to him—a man with a carefree, frivolous smile. What awaits Sangha next, salvation or damnation?!

(Source: Yen Press)

181321.description:
The story of a playboy that loves to fool around with girls... getting topped by a younger woman with an unfriendly attitude.

No role reversals, no turning the tables, no switching. She teases him from start to end, and he moans and groans in the throes of passion.
synonyms: The girl I had my eyes on at a new student party was a dominant top with a cold attitude.

title.native: 新歓で目をつけた子は、塩対応の攻め女子でした。
title.romaji: Shinkan de Me wo Tsuketa Ko wa, Shiotaiou no Seme Joshi deshita.

181323.description:
When Chise was 8 years old, she met a boy named Chihaya. After losing his parents, Chihaya was taken in by Chise's family. Chise and Chihaya are now unrelated siblings... But they are gradually drawn to each other. But a cruel fate awaits them...

(Source: Ciao Comics, translated)
synonyms: Even If This Love is a Sin

title.native: この恋が、罪だとしても
title.romaji: Kono Koi ga, Zaida to Shitemo

title.native: ツレない柳田さんと色恋がシたいです｡〜イケメン教育係の豹変に要注意⁉︎
title.romaji: Shirenai Yanagida-san to Irokoi ga Shitai desu.: Ikemen Kyouikugakari no Hyouhen ni Youchuui!?

181325.description:
My true identity and these feelings must remain absolute secrets.

Lily is an anonymous influencer who is gaining popularity online. But her true identity is Shirayuri Sakio, an ordinary and overlooked second-year junior-high girl! It was suppose to be her secret, but Sena, a popular boy in her class, is about to find out...? Secret feelings overflow. A miraculous Cinderella story.

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

Notes:
- Includes four extra chapters, including a bonus chapter for "Oshaberi Closet (おしゃべりクロゼット)"
- Includes the one-shot "Cutie♡Complex (キューティ♡コンプレックス)"
- Includes the one-shot "Suki Sugite Mirai Yohou (好きすぎて未来予報)"

181327.description: A collection of short stories from the popular series "Double Breed".

title.native: ダブルブリッド Drop Blood
さよなら私のクズ旦那

181330.description:
Passing by the riverside at twilight, Mahiru sees a beautiful boy. The next day, she meets him again as a high school classmate. The boy, Shio, is a bit of a mystery, but for some reason he seems to be interested in the shadowy Mahiru. One day, Mahiru discovers a big secret about Shio's family!

A pure and simple story of different races and friendships.

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

181331.description:
Hasumi, a university student who meets with misfortune whenever she does anything, is interested in Oikawa, who helped her out at the entrance ceremony.
However, when she steels herself to talk to him, he doesn't even remember her... Then, at the suggestion of her older brother, who noticed how amusing Hasumi's game-playing was, she decides to livestream a let's play. The video unexpectedly goes viral, and Oikawa has found it too...?

Gaming livestreamer x unlaughing guy—who will be the one to get hooked?

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: The Unlucky Game Streamer Is Charged by the Person of Her Dream.

title.native: ツイてないゲーム実況者は憧れの人に課金される
title.romaji: Tsuitenai Game Jikkyousha wa Akogare no Hito ni Kakinsareru

181332.description:
"My first love was as sweet as a strawberry and as indelible as a curse."

I was 16 years old. The day I was about to confess my love to the person I love, my life was forcibly reset.

Ayase Nico, age 20. Since that incident, her motto has been "live in the moment." One day, while her first love was smoldering in her heart, she had an encounter that could only be fate...!

The love triangle of destiny begins to move...
synonyms: Short Cake no Ichigo wa Itsu Taberu?

title.native: ショートケーキの苺はいつ食べる？
title.romaji: Shortcake no Ichigo wa Itsu Taberu?

title.native: 女神から『孵化』のスキルを授かった俺が、なぜか幻獣や神獣を従える最強テイマーになるまで
title.romaji: Megami kara “Fuka” no Skill wo Sazukatta Ore ga, Naze ka Genjuu-ya Shinjuu wo Shitaeru Saikyou Tamer ni Naru made

181334.description:
"I'm having a hard time, I'm in pain, I want to die."

Depression, panic disorder, addictions...

For all those who are suffering from such difficulties in life that they wish to die, Psychiatrist Rinko is busy working to ease their troubles. Then one day, her precious daughter attempts to commit suicide...? Waking up in the body of her daughter, she tries to find the cause.

181335.description:
Couples are suddenly thrown into a deadly game! Only those with "true love" can survive. But what's this? Two strangers who just met on a dating app are joining too?! With shaky bonds and lots of confusion, this super-duper intense game is about to begin!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: マッチングアプリで知り合った人と今日死ぬんだ
title.romaji: Matching Appli de Shiriatta Hito to Kyou Shinun da

title.native: 恋は空から降ってくる

181337.description:
Anna Matsumoto works for an apparel brand she has always loved. She is excited to be transferred from sales to the press department, but her supervisor is Kaoru Hisayo, a famous playboy in the company... This is an office love story between a hardworking girl who hates men and her boss, who is a playboy but good at his job.

(Source: natalie, translated)
synonyms: My Girlfriend Wants to Bite Me

title.native: カノジョは俺にかみつきたい

181338.description:
To save one, she'll kill the other.

A miraculous, 1-in-200,000 chance birth of conjoined twins. The probability of their survival? Less than 5%. Born with just one heart between the two of them, the Kang sisters face a sinister fate: for one to survive, the other must die. Their mother faces a horrible choice. How would you decide?

(Source: Manta)

synonyms: The Plain Girl Sitting Next to Me

title.native: となりの席の地味な奴
title.romaji: Tonari no Seki no Jimi na Yatsu

181340.description:
1. Game no Namae (ゲームの名前)
2. Diamond Life (ダイアモンド・ライフ)
3. Nageku Nari Waga Yoru no Fantasy (嘆くなり我が夜のファンタジー)
synonyms: ダイアモンド・ライフ
嘆くなり我が夜のファンタジー
Nageku Nari Waga Yoru no Fantasy

title.native: ＭＡＩＤｅｓーメイデスーメイド、地獄の戦場に転送される。固有のゴミ収集魔法で、最弱クラスのまま人類最強に。
title.romaji: MAIDes: Maid, Jjgoku no Senjou ni Tensou Sareru. Koyuu no Gomi Shuushuu Mahou de, Saijaku Class no Mama Jinrui Saikyou ni.

181342.description:
"...W-w-what should I do? I'm stuck in a hellish battlefield!"

Humanity lies on the brink of extinction, caught in a war against demonic beasts. One day, the young maid Orsera is inadvertently teleported into a forest on the front lines of the war. She has no weapons nor combat experience, all she has is a useless magic skill that "summons things that people don't need."

When she encounters a large dragon beast, she finds herself in dire straits. She takes a gamble and summons a magical weapon called a revolver, and new class of hero is born!?

It turns out her useless skill is actually better suited to fighting these beasts than any other magic… Before she knew it, she has become the last hope for humanity!?

The weakest maid will rise to power and carve out a future for humanity!
Facing apocalyptic odds, a survival fantasy begins!

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

title.native: ＭＡＩＤｅｓ─メイデス─メイド、地獄の戦場に転送される。固有のゴミ収集魔法で、最弱クラスのまま人類最強に。@COMIC
title.romaji: MAIDes: Maid, Jjgoku no Senjou ni Tensou Sareru. Koyuu no Gomi Shuushuu Mahou de, Saijaku Class no Mama Jinrui Saikyou ni. @COMIC

181345.description:
I'll keep this a secret from your husband…

Note: Published in COMIC X-EROS #55

title.native: 牢の中で目覚めた悪役令嬢は死にたくない ～処刑を回避したら、待っていたのは溺愛でした～
title.romaji: Rou no Naka de Mezameta Akuyaku Reijou wa Shinitakunai: Shokei wo Kaihi Shitara, Matte Ita no wa Dekiai Deshita

181347.description:
Yume Kawai, an 18-year-old, is about to start her first day as a working adult. Through sheer passion and determination, she's managed to secure a job at her dream company—a renowned fancy goods manufacturer responsible for creating beloved characters like Twinkle Kururu, which Yume adores. However, Yume harbors a secret: due to a hurtful comment from a boy in her childhood, she has suppressed her genuine love for all things cute. Now, as she embarks on her professional journey, Yume must confront her hidden feelings and rediscover her true self.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

181348.description:
In Garin’s hometown, the small island of Young-do, there exists a legend known to all who live there. Every person who leaves Young-Do is cursed by the mountain god and will face all kinds of misfortune.

“If… If… you’ve really cursed me… If you lift it… I’ll do anything!”

“I’ll grant your wish, but in return…Give yourself to me and become my bride.”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

181350.description:
The Sky tore asunder, and humans from another world, possessing extraordinary abilities, emerged! Joan, on a quest to discover to use magic, stumbles across Byungcheol, a human from another world, and starts to get involved in unforeseen events.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

181352.description:
The story unfolds in 1543 Japan, when a boy destined to become the "Strongest of the Warring States" encounters a mysterious blue-eyed girl.

(Source: Harta, translated)

title.native: アルケミックガール×バーサーカーボーイ
万能スキルの劣等聖女 ～器用すぎるので貧乏にはなりませんでした～
title.romaji: Bannou Skill no Rettou Seijo: Kiyou Sugiru node Binbou ni wa Narimasen Deshita

181355.description:
The story begins in northern India in 1983. Due to certain circumstances, a woman named Maya Chauhan visits the territory of the female bandit Karina Lakshmi. Maya ends up joining the bandit group and embarking on a dangerous journey with them...

(Source: Harta, translated)

181356.description:
The sisters, Joanne and Jasmine, enter the realty business to escape their hellish past. Will the sisters be able to make it?

(Source: Toomics)

181357.description:
A request was sent to two manga artists, M and H, from the editorial department of the Ichijinsha comic HOWL.

"I would like you to create artwork based on the name (storyboard) for 'SCP,' which is popular on the internet. Additionally, I would like you to draw a manga that serves as an introduction to 'SCP."

The two accepted the project, but there were many unknowns about the original name. While tilting his head in confusion, M — who is learning about SCP from H, who is knowledgeable about horror — continues to draw the manga. M will be in charge of the introduction part, and H will handle the artwork for the original name part.

title.native: ぼくの壊れた正義はループする異世界で愛と罪を天秤にかける
title.romaji: Boku no Kowareta Seigi wa Loop Suru Isekai de Ai to Tsumi wo Tenbin ni Kakeru

title.native: ヴィーナスミッション～元殺し屋で傭兵の中年、勇者の暗殺を依頼され異世界転生！～
title.romaji: Venus Mission: Moto Koroshiya de Youhei no Chuunen, Yuusha no Ansatsu wo Iraisare Isekai Tensei!

181361.description:
A cruel tale of Tokyo in the Reiwa era, told by adults who couldn't grasp anything in this city where everything is supposedly within reach.

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

181362.description:
Shintaro Ojiro, 39 years old. Low education, low income - what you'd call a bottom-tier citizen. A man who has continually lost and been deprived, cut off from society, at the end of his loneliness and despair, decides to assassinate a politician...

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

title.native: アマチュアビジランテ
スライムライフ特別編 ヨルルのパンケーキ
title.romaji: Slime Life Tokubetsu-hen: Yorul no Pancake

181364.description:
Welcome to "Mountain Loft." A reality TV show featuring 4 men and women aiming to win a million dollars. Oh, and anything goes!

(Source: Toomics)

181365.description:
Once the daughter of a powerful noble, Hwi-yeon now lives as the daughter of a traitor. To survive, she disguises herself as a man and lives a quiet life in hiding. Her concealment seems to go smoothly. Until…

"What's gotten into you, my lord?!"

"You really do not know why?"

"I don't know. I'm not interested in such...perversions. Please let me go."

"What a pity...because I am very interested in these things you claim to have no interest in."

 Everything changes when she accidentally encounters Prince Cheong-wun, the beautiful libertine of the Kingdom of Geumyul and her former betrothed. As old desires resurface and new dangers arise, Hwi-yeon must navigate a perilous game of deception and passion, where the stakes are nothing less than her very survival. Will she be able to keep her true identity hidden, or will her disguised desires lead to her undoing?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

title.native: 新・時空のクロス・ロード

181367.description: A collection of misanthropic and paranoid-schizophrenic oneshots.

181370.description:
Can two lovers find their way back into each other’s arms?

(Source: Toomics)

181372.description:
As queen, Marie had it made: she spent her days in luxury and her nights bedding multiple beautiful women. Alas, her tyrannical ways eventually caused her downfall, and her people sent her to the guillotine. Yet when the blade drops down, Marie doesn’t die. Instead, she wakes up one year in the past! Stuck in an endless loop, nothing she tries seems to change her fate. Her only chance of avoiding certain death is to win over the countless women who have it in for her…by seducing them one by one! A brand-new bawdy yuri comedy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Death Defying Princess Creates a Yuri Harem to Survive
title.native: 死に戻り王女は生き延びるために百合ハーレムを作ることにした
title.romaji: Shi ni Modori Oujo wa Ikinobiru Tameni Yuri Harem wo Tsukuru Koto ni Shita

181373.description:
Thoughtful young man (⍺) x introverted creator (Ω)

Love remakes life!!

Luca – creator of the famous character Mimigel – is an illustrator with an introverted personality. Because he was tired of being changed too much, not to his liking, he gave up the copyright to the character Mimigel and took a plane to move to a far away place to live. During his flight, the plane suddenly had a shaking problem. Before he knew it, he found himself in a world where strange words like "second gender," "omega," "sex" were everywhere.

And what will his new life be like?!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title.native: 弱虫オメガは溺愛されたい
転生ナイチンゲールは夜明けを歌う〜薄幸の辺境令嬢は看護の知識で家族と領地を救います!〜
title.romaji: Tensei Nightingale wa Yoake wo Utau: Hakkou no Henkyou Reijou wa Kango no Chishiki de Kazoku to Ryouchi wo Sukuimasu!

181375.description:
Two clandestine lovers spend their days together in a world that won't accept them for who they are. Kanae, a teacher, reflects on her and her girlfriend's circumstances. Meanwhile, her lover prepares a surprise for her...

Masterfully pensive yuri from Rion Nomiya about what one really needs to be happy.

(Source: Yuri Hub)

181376.description:
Do you ever truly know the people around you? The lives they lead, the jobs they do, the emotions they feel? Unknown Caller explores three sweet-yet-spicy tales of romance, intrigue, and drama, showing that sometimes it’s the unknown that’s the most rewarding.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ใครก็ได้ รับสายความรักหน่อย

181377.description: A partial retelling of Hanako Yamada's life, one full of cynicism, paranoia, social estrangement, and fear.

181378.description:
Yamada is an ordinary character who is recognized by everyone and is a "nice guy". When the members of Tomino Middle School are gathered as usual, Kano and Tsubaki confess that they are dating. Yamada is shocked to find out that Tsubaki, who he has admired since middle school, is dating the dull Kano. However, after consulting Murasaki about his feelings, Yamada begins to develop feelings for Murasaki...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 恋だの愛だの～君は僕の太陽だ～
title.romaji: Koi dano Ai dano: Kimi wa Boku no Taiyou da

181379.description: Manga adaptation of Penthesilea's interlude side-story from the Fate/Grand Order mobile game.
synonyms: Fate/Grand Order: Penthesilea's Interlude - The Phantom of Troia

title.native: ペンテシレイア 幕間の物語 「トロイアの幻影」
title.romaji: Fate/Grand Order: Penthesilea Makuai no Monogatari "Troia no Genei"

181380.description:
At the end of your life… If you were given one more chance, what would you choose?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

title.native: 推しがアシスタントに来た話
title.romaji: Oshi ga Assistant ni Kita Hanashi

title.native: 愛され皇妃のゆううつ

181386.description:
The main character is a miserly court lady, Kougyoku, who is greedy for money. She fell in love with the current emperor, Huang Lianhe, after he saved her from a pinch when she was young, and so she entered the harem to meet him again. While carrying out her duties in the harem, she meets a military officer who reminds her of Lianhe in some way...

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)
synonyms: Love Is Golden in the Inner Palace

181387.description:
It was easy for him to imagine myself in these clothes. How Kousuke would touch him, how he would hold him...

Takane, an honor student and vice president of the student council, has a secret routine. It is to comfort himself in drag while fantasizing about being embraced by his childhood friend Kosuke. One night, after completing his usual routine, Takane falls asleep while wearing a skirt. Kosuke, who happens to be visiting his home, sees him in the skirt...?

"Takane, let me see what you looked like yesterday one more time."

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Undress me if you love me

181388.description:
Utao Hananoi hides that she is actually a human, even though she goes to a vampire highschool. One day she is found out by the vampire progenitor Shirotae. In a world where humans are food, Utao and Shirotae find themselves oddly drawn to each other.

(Source: Comic Boost, translated)

181389.description:
In the late Showa era, Fuko Furomiya is a lively fifth-grade girl who works at the "Funadeyu" bathhouse in Osaka. This is a humble, bittersweet story of everyday life as seen through the eyes of Fuko.

(Source: Comic Action, translated)

181390.description:
One day, a hot horny woman moves in the next door! But she’s married and her moans drive Tom crazy!

(Source: Toomics)

181391.description:
1. Yokubou Kyoushitsu (欲望教室); Comic Shigekiteki Squirt!! Vol.3
2. Oujigasaki Sakurako wa Hameguruitai! (王路ヶ崎桜子はハメ狂いたい！); Comic JSCK Vol.10
3. Nikubenki Iinkai (肉便器委員会); Comic JSCK Vol.8
4. Tokkun Menu (特訓メニュー); Comic JSCK Vol.7
5. Kaerimichi (On The Way Home, 帰り道); Comic JSCK Vol.6
6. Nouzui Haretsu Concrete Jungle (脳髄破裂コンクリートジャングル); Comic JSCK Vol.4
7. Bitch na Perfect (ビッチなパーフェクト); Comic JSCK Vol.3
8. Gakkyuu Nikubenki Mizushima Sawako (学級肉便器 木嶋佐和子); Comic JSCK Vol.3
9. Sukkiri Workout! (スッキリワークアウト！); Comic Ero-tama 2015-09
10. Gyakunan Amusement (逆ナンアミューズメント); Comic Ero-tama 2015-07
11. Enchou Shimasuka? (延長しますか？); Comic Shigekiteki Squirt!! Vol.2
12. Classmate (クラスメート); Comic JSCK Vol.11

title.native: 放課後ギャルハメ肉便器
住みこみ先はお墨つき。～若頭に飼われてます～
title.romaji: Juu Mikomi-saki wa Oboku Tsuki. Wakatama ni Kawaretemasu

181393.description: One day, the protagonist started to see hearts flying out of his crush's head.

181394.description:
"I'd love to see the look on senpai's face when she falls in love.”

Chisaki, a dating show enthusiast, has helped numerous couples come together, earning her the nickname "Matchup Senpai." She has plenty of knowledge, but she doesn't actually have any personal experience with romance, and she's given up on her own love life. Until she falls in love with a junior boy, Leo!　

While still supporting her friends, she finally decides to write her own love story with Leo-kun!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: わたしの恋のはじめかた

title.romaji: Sora to Pan to Koujou to

181396.description:
Ena, a high school girl, is working part-time as a housekeeper. Her new customer, Mikanagi-san, is a manga artist. Mikanagi, who seems so cool and unapproachable, suddenly asks Ena to “teach him to JK” to help with the manga he's working on. Now they do things like go out to the beach and take purikura pictures together. But is this all suppose to be part of the job? Because this close relationship is getting her all flustered! A love story between a cool and handsome guy and his “youth teacher" is about to begin!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: アオハルだなんて君のせい

181397.description:
1-2. Tsuyatsuma Arijigoku (艶妻蟻地獄); Comic KURiBERON Duma Vol.18, 19
3. Zaiakukan to Kairakushugi (罪悪感と快楽主義); Comic KURiBERON Duma Vol.4
4. Aiyoku no Wana (愛欲の罠); Comic KURiBERON Duma Vol.6
5. Dain no Utage (堕淫の宴); Comic KURiBERON Duma Vol.8
6. Junketsu no Kyozou (純潔の虚像); Comic KURiBERON Duma Vol.9
7. Inmu no You ni Okasarete (淫夢のように犯されて); Comic KURiBERON Duma Vol.13
8. Otousan ni Otosarete (お義父さんに堕とされて); Comic KURiBERON Duma Vol.14
9. Wakazuma Arijigoku (若妻蟻地獄); Comic KURiBERON Duma Vol.11

181398.description:
Why not unwind in another world once in a while? High schooler Kudo Akira happens upon the ability to travel between Japan and the fantastical world of Do-Melta. Not bound by any dire mission or duty, he leisurely enjoys exploring his way through the massive dungeon in the center of the world and all the trappings that come with it. The guild receptionist is trying to mooch off of him, his magic instructor has "rewards" for him, and he just might have some fun with a girl he saves...

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 放課後の迷宮冒険者 ～日本と異世界を行き来できるようになった僕はレベルアップに勤しみます～
title.romaji: Houkago no Dungeon Diver: Nihon to Isekai wo Ikiki Dekiru You ni Natta Boku wa Level Up ni Isoshimimasu

181399.description:
We'll make our customers' dreams come true~

Nozomu is a university student who works at a "dream shop" using his incubus powers. One day, a young man named Kokuyou visits the shop, saying he can't remember his dreams. Nozomu starts to perform the treatment, but he can't control it properly, and Kokuyou makes a move on him in the dream?! Even though the treatment didn't work, from that day forward, he keeps requesting Nozomu's services?!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 夢で逢えたら覚悟して

She was a plain, makeup-free girl who successfully debuted as a "shiny" student when she started university!

After discovering her secret, Sagara, in an effort to preserve his peaceful loner life, decides to help the clumsy Haruko.

"If you really manage to become one of those shiny girls, you won’t need to bother me anymore, right?"

"Sagara-kun, you're so difficult sometimes..."

If her true self is exposed, her rosy campus life is sure to crumble! What will happen to the awkward youth of this dull loner and a fake shiny girl!?
181489.hashtag: #嘘つきリップは恋で崩れる #嘘つきリップ
synonyms: Liar's Lips Fall Apart In Love

title.native: 嘘つきリップは恋で崩れる
title.romaji: Usotsuki Lip wa Koi de Kuzureru

181491.description:
Before her accident, Lucette was a young woman living in modern-day Korea. So why did she wake up in the body of a little girl living in the remote outskirts of the Vladin Empire? That was the setting of the ultra-violent webnovel she was reading when she was hit by a truck! But since things have come to this, Lucette might as well get her hustle on, far away from the dangerous capital. At least, that's what she thought before befriending a brilliant but mysterious boy named Lev. What will happen as their growing bond unveils a life-threatening secret?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 陰キャな幼馴染が実は暴君でした

title.english: The Nerd is Actually a Tyrant
title.romaji: Nerd Man Algo Boni Pokgunira Hamnida

181493.description:
Shiori Kitano, is a JK Student who works hard at her schoolwork, club activities, and part-time job. Her days are fast-paced, but her favorite pastime is playing the otome game "Real ni Tokite" also known as "Ria Tokime" , which is her way of taking a break and relaxing. She gets her daily energy from her favorite character, Amane Yukihira. "I wish he was real."

One morning, while I was wishing that, Amane Yukihira appeared in my room at...??

title.native: 乙女ゲーの推しが逆トリップしてきた話。
title.romaji: Otomege no Oshi ga Gyaku Trip Shite Kita Hanashi.

181494.description:
Ever since he was young, Leo struggled with many things that came easily to others. Both in his daily life and at work, he grew tired of himself for always causing trouble for those around him. Then one day, Leo got into a terrible traffic accident. When he woke up, he discovered that his brain had been replaced with a machine...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

181496.description:
Fione is a well-respected witch who has reared many successful apprentices throughout her life—but when a particularly stubborn apprentice begins to make advances on her, she has no idea how to react. Little does she know she’s already completely wrapped around Stella’s finger…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: Lust Lessons with My Witchcraft Tutor
title.native: 魔女先生の発情レッスン

181497.description:
Cursed to be an ugly cat--but maybe you're happy!

"I'll have you turn into a cat, sister."

Marie, the viscount's young daughter, lost her fiancé to her younger sister Emilia and has been cursed even more. Her reflection in the mirror - an ugly cat! Running away from her sister for her life, Marie, who escaped from their house, collapsed from loneliness and hunger, unable to speak.

Then, a kind hand reaches out to her, "In the middle of this rain, poor thing...Would you like to come with me?" The figure is the "ruthless, merciless, undefeated duke" rumored even in social circles.

An unfortunate girl gets her one and only happiness, and a happy cat life begins!
synonyms: A Timid Lady was Turned into an Ugly Cat, but on the Verge of Fainting is Picked up by the Most Fearsome Military Duke

title.native: ブサ猫に変えられた気弱令嬢ですが、最恐の軍人公爵に拾われて気絶寸前です
title.romaji: Busa Neko ni Kaerareta Kiyowa Reijou desu ga, Saikyou no Gunjin Koushaku ni Hirowarete Kizetsu Sunzen desu

181498.description:
The super handsome commander sorcerer Ray is so popular with the ladies that he's become uncomfortable with them. One day, his grandmother pressures him into going on a blind date, and there he meets Bridget, a workaholic auditor.

When Ray learns that Bridget had given up on getting married just like him, he proposes a contract marriage to put an end to their blind dates. But when they begin their married life, and get closer by the day, they find it surprisingly fun?

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: Contract Marriage of the Grand Master Sorcerer's

title.native: 魔術師団長の契約結婚

181499.description:
Solo adventurer and hero Leon was a master of all trades: sword-fighting, magic, healing, you name it. When he single-handedly defeated the Demon King, a curse was placed upon the lone hero. Without a party to save him, they both met their tragic ends.

Years later, a timid noble boy is attacked by an ogre, triggering memories of his past life as the great hero who shares his name—Leon! With these memories recovered and powers reawakened, Leon decides to start a new carefree journey!

(Source: Manga Up! Global)

title.english: The Carefree Journey of the Reincarnated Hero

synonyms: Nami SOS! - Incubi Hunter Nami First Battle

181504.description: The "108 Thieves' Tools" were once used by Alibaba, a great thief of the distant past. Each one of them has a power that defies reason, and has become the greatest treasure of the modern era. It is said that if one obtains all 108 tools, one can "steal the world." Thieves from all over the world are fighting in pursuit of this hidden treasure, and Kaito, a boy fascinated by the romance of the story, also sets out on a journey! A new serialization of a "thief" battle fantasy begins!!

title.native: 帰れ！大鶴谷帰宅倶楽部
マリカスイングミーアラウンド

181510.description:
A two-volume collection of the mangaka "match" including both one-shots and short series.

Volume 1: Heart no Okurimono (ハートのおくりもの) [2022-12]
1-4. Heart no Okurimono (ハートのおくりもの)
Shiro had a weak heart, so she had been bedridden since she was little. A girl from her neighborhood named Kuro would always visit her and keep her company throughout the years. Eventually, Shiro's condition got to the point where she needed a transplant, or else she would die. Kuro then offers her heart to Shiro, and has hers replaced by a mechanical one. This story is about them adjusting to their new hearts and to their feelings for each other.

5-7. Futatsu no Rasen (ふたつのラセン)
Through the use of her research in parthenogenesis genetics, Kita-san from the Sciences and Mathematics Department had been able to have a child with a star athlete in the Physical Education Department, Minami-san. This is the story of how their child and family came to be.

8. Fujimi Ningen no Shuukatsu ~ Fukkatsu (不死身人間の就活〜ふっかつ！〜)

Volume 2: Tenshi no Bokujo (天使の牧場) [2023-04]
1-5. Tenshi no Bokujo (天使の牧場)
Welcome to Saint Basileia, a school for producing and raising genetically superior human beings! It's here where sacred and profane lineages are curated and one's worth is determined by genes alone. At the top of this hierarchy are the students clothed all in white who contain within them the lineages of angels and saints, androgynous beings called "Nephilim." It is the duty of the other students to provide them with daily care and genetic material to ensure the continuation and perfection of these lines.

6-8. Restart wa Zero kara (リスタートはゼロから)
…“She” is not the only one. A young girl, who suffered from a severe case of identity disorder, was abandoned by her parents and came to live together with her attending physician. Despite their peculiar relationship, the two were leading a quiet and comfortable life, until...
synonyms: リスタートはゼロから
不死身人間の就活～ふっかつ～
不死身人間の就活〜ふっかつ！

181511.description:
"Gamemaster," a high school streamer, dedicated his life to beating the supposedly unbeatable game "Hero's Destiny." Finally succeeding after ten years, the realization that he's wasted his life is short-lived, as the game asks him to keep playing—only for him to wake up inside the game after he agrees, in the body of Callix Szcecin, the meek young son of a count. Together with Lyla, the maid and assassin hired by his stepmother who failed to kill him, Russel, the loyal knight, and Kraut, a young knight with much potential, Callix must survive the game again, in person.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Reversal of My Life as a Side Character

title.romaji: Mob na Ore no Gyakuten Jinsei

181512.description:
The year is 1887 in the rolling hills of the French countryside. The estate of Viscount de Rougemerle gently basks in its verdant glory, a beacon in the twilight years of the aristocracy. With the return of the viscount’s wayward son Cameron, however, the tranquility of this stately home threatens to shatter into scandal. It falls upon Edgar O’Grady, an Irish butler in service of the Rougemerles, to maintain decorum in the household, all the while protecting his childhood friend June and his master’s daughter Lady Victoria, as each furtive glance gleams the emerald green of envy…

(Source: WEBTOON)

181513.description:
After a fatal carriage accident, Rumiere Lashantia wakes up disoriented and is diagnosed with amnesia. While her identity and distant memories remain intact, her recent memories seem to have been erased. In her journal, she finds a chilling entry: “You can’t love him.” The man in question is Carl Winger, her ex-lover, whom she broke up with days before. Despite not remembering him, Rumiere is drawn to Carl and is determined to uncover the truth about the nature of their relationship.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Since I Don’t Remember Anything About It, Shall We Break Up, Your Majesty?
陛下，我失憶了，可以分手嗎？

title.english: We've Already Broken Up, Your Majesty

181514.description:
On his daughter’s wedding day, a father dies and mysteriously reincarnates as the family dog in her new home. As he adjusts to his canine form, he uncovers a shocking secret: his seemingly perfect son-in-law might be unfaithful. With keen senses and newfound determination, this papa dog must protect his daughter from betrayal. Can he save her from heartache without revealing his true identity?

(Source: WEBTOON)

181515.description:
Dullahan, the demon lord who once terrorized the world, finally revives in modern-day Korea, eager to take revenge against the hero who defeated her centuries ago. But all she can find is his descendant, Yong-Rae Kim: a hapless, incompetent office worker with no prospects and no joy in life. Ending his life now would only be doing him a favor, so Dullahan decides to improve his life first… but Yong-Rae's two-timing girlfriend and his many strict superiors at work stand in the way. Can Dullahan crush the office hierarchy and awaken Yong-Rae's dormant hero abilities to make her revenge more satisfying?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.english: The New Hire is the Demon Lord

181516.description:
Eliana Rose was supposed to have her happily ever after when she married a handsome baron. But after the wedding, she learns the truth about her new husband: he’s in love with another woman. Even worse, the baron’s mistress is none other than his own adopted daughter, Lady Charhen. Heartbroken and betrayed, Eliana devises a master plan to secure her rightful place in high society and save her family. Her path forward is treacherous, but to secure a fortune, a lady must be bold.

(Source: Tapas)

181517.description:
The world is full of things I don't understand...

After breaking up with her boyfriend, our protagonist comes home to find a mysterious girl waiting at her door. A girl who somehow knows her nickname "Naako"...

An artistic and bittersweet gem by Rion Nomiya.

(Source: Yuri Hub)

title.romaji: Kouki Kokoro wa Neko wo Korosu

181518.description:
Lieutenant General Leto Okeanos, the Mad Dog of the Navy, runs a tight ship… except when it comes to matters of the heart. He’s met his match in Captain Noah Bello, a fiery subordinate and old flame. When Leto blocks her long-awaited promotion, Noah challenges him to a duel. The wager? A wish granted to the winner. Leto wins and proposes marriage. Caught between duty, desire, and Navy politics, these ex-lovers must decide: is their love a second chance... or a disaster waiting to sink them both?

(Source: Tapas)

181520.description:
Oh Sa-Rang, a FM high school student who is so principled that he is called a walking moral textbook. He has a special secret, and that is... "I only hear kind words"! On the other hand, other people's bad words or swear words are just noise to him. Sa-Rang, who has been living in a world full of noise, meets 'Lina', a girl with a pure and clear voice one day. Sa-Rang feels excitement for the first time in her life and follows her to the broadcasting club... but turns out she's a swearer?! So-Ri Na is a surprising girl who "translates bad words to people and hears them as kind words." However, for some reason, it doesn't work on Sa-rang. A two-way communication romance between 'Sa-Rang', who has heard swearing vividly for the first time in her life, and the sweariest girl in the school, 'Lina'!

(Source: Naver, translated)

181521.description:
From archenemies to fictional lovers!

Tae-Yeon is horrified when she finds herself co-teaching an after-school writing class with her college nemesis, Yong-Jin. Little does she realize that the worst is yet to come. They're in for a wild ride when they get sucked into a novel written by 8-year-olds, where absurdity becomes reality!

(Source: Manta)

181522.description:
After her parents died, Sami gave up her life of fortune to live independently, doing odd jobs to make ends meet. When she starts to get involved with two of the most popular boys at her high school, Sami faces twists and turns — Chan is her neighbor, and Pyo-Jun makes her have conflicted feelings. Things get more complicated when she finds out that Chan has feelings for Pyo-Jun as well! With her mom’s only keepsake in hand to keep her feet on the ground, Sami navigates obstacles that she wasn’t prepared for — and aren’t even in her budget!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

181523.description:
The night before Su-Jeong plans to confess her feelings for Do-Jin, she runs into him on the street and is devastated to find out that he doesn't even know her name. Too afraid to face him in class the next day, Su-Jeong hides in the storage locker, where she meets Do-Jin's younger brother Jae-Yun. With Jae-Yun's help, will she able to win Do-Jin's heart?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

181524.description:
After being transported into a novel she read, Agrain tries to live a quiet life as a side character maid. But that changes when the novel’s timeline is suddenly altered and she finds herself working directly for the terrifying Duke Ingord. Agrain knows that the only way she can survive now is to do anything he asks...but what exactly does he want from her?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: There Is No Counterattack From the Supporting Character

title.english: No Retaliation from the Supporting Cast

181525.description:
Hiro just wants to live a quiet, peaceful life, but she is curious about an orange-haired boy who passes by her on a pedestrian bridge? A story of pure first love.

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Margaret 2024 No. 18.

181526.description:
When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she’ll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel’s hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending -- easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona’s dangerous past, and the grand duke’s affections, can Rona stick to the story?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: กุมหัวใจอสูรตาบอด
Capture the Heart of the Blind Demon
La bête aveugle est à moi

title.english: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast

title.native: プライスレスマリッジ

181528.description:
After waking up as the villainess in a dark fantasy romance novel, Marlena was destined to be nothing more than the cold male lead’s scorned wife. Wanting no part in his cruel love story, she demanded a divorce. But just as she begins to enjoy her new life, both her ex-husband and the second male lead start chasing after her!

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: The Regretful Villainess Is Happy Because She Got Divorced

title.english: The Regretful Villainess Is Happily Divorced

181529.description:
Biwa, a 26-year-old office worker who is well respected within her company, thinks it's cool to be a girl who can live on her own, but she really wants to be spoiled by someone! She was so pampered by a persistent pick-up girl that she decided to help her out. She gets tangled up with a persistent pick-up artist, and falls in love with the man who saves her.

When she goes to work the next day, she finds that Tanaka, a junior colleague who has been assigned as her mentor, is the one she never expected to meet! And he's a very salt-of-the-earth guy who doesn't like women! But I will definitely make him want to spoil her!

The love battle between a girl who wants to be pampered and a salt-acting boy is about to begin!

title.native: 甘えたがりな彼女について

181530.description:
Diana Lesley, a renowned knight of the Agripana Kingdom, is killed by her rival Cornelius Heimann in the war against the Heverunia Empire. However, when she wakes up, she finds herself at 10 years old and decides to pursue the life of a proper lady instead of a knight—much to her family's disapproval. After becoming Princess Juliana's lady-in-waiting, she must contend with conniving noblewomen, the threat of oncoming war, and the affections of Cornelius who, in this life, dreams about her past life and falls for her. Can she keep her loved ones safe and live in peace?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Knight Becomes a Black Flower

181531.description:
Yijae Kang seems to have the worst luck. She’s an orphan, can see ghosts, and can’t go near water. To make matters worse, she reincarnates as Hailey Duncan, a noblewoman who took her own life before her marriage to King Rodrick of Kaien--who happens to have evil spirits attached to him! To help ease his burden, Hailey's days are spent exorcising these spirits. The more they spend time together, the better Rodrick seems to feel…could he be falling for her?

(Source: Tapas)

181532.description:
"Mr. Hyde, I'm getting married."

Hyde, a cold and love-averse individual, is tasked by the prince to go undercover as the tutor of Lily, the adopted daughter of Viscount Bardin, to uncover clues about illegal firearm trafficking.

"And who will be the lucky gentleman to take your hand in marriage, my lady?"

"Lord Lucien Sornell, the first son of Count Sornell. Are you perhaps acquainted with him?"

During his mission, Hyde discovers that his innocent and demure pupil, Lily, is engaged to Lucien, a notorious rake in high society. Ahh, yes. She's been adopted to be married off, so I guess now is when she comes in handy.

"Mr. Hyde, what do you think the lord likes in a woman?"

With her big, innocent eyes, Lily looks so pure, yet she has the delicate beauty of a painting. Her body is frail, yet she is well-developed in all the right places, and utterly adorable. For just one week, she vows to become the most beloved bride.

"Mr. Hyde, if it’s not too much trouble, will you teach me how to do it?"

"Of course, Lady Lily. Teaching you is the greatest joy and pleasure I've known in life."

Though Hyde despises getting his hands dirty and is in a constant rivalry with Lucien, he decides to masquerade as a genuine tutor, teaching Lily the refined ways of noble romance to give Lucien a taste of his own medicine. Will Hyde’s lessons turn Lily into the perfect bride, or will they uncover deeper, more dangerous secrets?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: บทเรียนรักคุณหนู

181533.description:
She wants a love that burns... not something empty or restrained.

(Source: Toomics)

181535.description:
Yoo Sera, who once secretly indulged in the R-rated, grimdark captivity reverse-harem game "Who Trapped Our Lady?", suddenly finds herself thrown into the world of that very game. Not only is she forced into the body of the villainess Sera Ebott, but she’s also trapped under the same roof as the male leads who despise her. The condition for escape? Uncover the identity of the one who imprisoned her. To survive and gain the information she needs, Sera must seduce those very men with her own body…!! Will Sera find a way out and return safely?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Trapped With Male Leads Who Hate Me
วังวนสวาท ล้วงรักเหล่าหนุ่มหล่อ

181536.description:
Ji Yu is a lowly temp, the kind who gets bullied by her boss every day. Luckily, the department is getting a new boss returning from overseas, who is said to be beautiful and kind to her subordinates. But she didn’t expect that this new boss is actually an ex-girlfriend who has a grudge against her!

Ji Yu was young and reckless in school, so when she fell in love with a timid junior girl, she harassed the younger girl with hugs and kisses even when she refused. Eventually, Ji Yu even forced Le Churan to go out with her. But when she graduated, Ji Yu felt guilty and decided to give the junior girl back her freedom by writing a long breakup letter, deleting her contact info, and going far away.

Nowadays, nobody would believe it if Ji Yu said that she used to bully Le Churan around. When Ji Yu writes, a report, Le Churan says, "This doesn't make sense. Rewrite it." When Ji Yu glanced at someone else, Le Churan threatens her, "I can fire you for having an improper relationship at work."

Gradually, their conversations became a little strange.
"Kiss me and I'll write the report for you," Le Churan said with a serious expression.
"Let's hold hands for an hour and you can have a day off tomorrow."
"Come home with me... and I'll do anything you want me to."

(Source: Billibilli, translated)

title.native: 前女友成了我的顶头上司
title.romaji: Qian Nüyou Cheng Le Wo De Dingtou Shangsi

181537.description:
All Margo wanted was some peace and quiet, even if she had to kill her husband to get it. She thought she’d gotten away with it too. She never expected the snowstorm or to be trapped in her house with suspicious eyes watching her every move. Margo’s fate lies in the hands of a strange maid, Peggy, who catches her in the act of destroying evidence. But what will Margo do when the touch of those hands makes her tremble with pleasure? Will she find her respite, or be forced to kill again?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: レディーブラックは憂鬱だ

181538.description:
Despite standing by Black Dragon Akelans’ side for 14 years as his loyal vassal, Hasolan was never accepted as his mate, her love left unrequited until the day she took her own life. But upon opening her eyes, Hasolan finds herself back in the past on the day she first awakened Akelans. Though she tries to change her fate in this life, she ends up in the merciless dragon’s clutches once more. Except this time, there’s something different about him. To Hasolan’s shock, Akelans acknowledges her as his mate right away. But at this point, it may be too late...

(Source: Tappytoon)

181540.description:
While tracking down the thief Queen of Hearts, Cen Jing was accidentally handcuffed to a pole dancer in a bar. When she was in a state of panic, she discovered that the sexy and charming dancer was actually Ji Shuangrong, a simple girl whom she had once supported. In order to "lead the little sister back to the right path", Cen Jing went deep into every aspect of Ji Shuangrong's life. The seemingly simple Ji Shuangrong was the thief that Cen Jing was tracking down - the Queen of Hearts. There are more secrets behind her...

(source: Billibilli, translated)
synonyms: Feelings Arises When Your Hands Are Tied

181541.description:
A young man crashes during a race. As he falls to the ground, he begins a journey to rediscover his roots. A 30-page one-shot story of a boy and a tranquil craftsman!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

181542.description:
Life isn’t always perfect, but love certainly makes it better. The exciting tale of young love continues a year following the story “Seasons of Blossom.” Bo-Mi and her university classmate Pu-Reum’s lives center around a new place, “Cafe Blossom & Nemone Art Studio,” as they navigate the joy and hardships of university and professional life.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

181543.description:
Unpopular underground idol and actress, Enatsu Sayuki, faces her work diligently everyday to achieve her dreams of making it big in the world of acting. ...However, for some reason, the superstar idol Sera Touma—who should be her rival—becomes her biggest fan!! Adorable enough to make Sayuki jealous, Sera takes every chance to passionately declare her love, throwing Sayuki’s life into chaos. Will Sayuki be able to achieve her dreams? And what will become of the one-sided love(?) between Sera and Sayuki…!? The curtain rises on the clash between these young talents in the fierce age of idol showbiz—let the show begin!!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title.native: 鬼売れアイドルが今日も私を推してくる
title.romaji: Oni Ure Idol ga Kyou mo Watashi wo Oshitekuru

181544.description:
“When the fog thickens, they’ll come, with faces that are exactly the same as before.”

Seo-Uri, who has lived her entire life as the daughter of a murderer, heads to her maternal grandmother’s rural village after hearing news of her grandmother’s death. There, she encounters a ghost incident that is exactly the same as the one her mother experienced 18 years ago.

(Source: Naver, translated)

181545.description:
After waking up in a goblin's body and getting brutally killed by humans, Jace Hurley triggers a life simulation game system. By continuously evolving, the blessed goblin crawls all the way up to become the world's strongest fighter. The Saint of Swords, the dragon mother Fryrmiel, angels, and goddesses have all succumbed to his charms.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Goblin's Ascent: From Loser to Winner

181546.description:
Dowon chose to be a freelance guide for the freedom to do other things, but his cold and demanding esper, Kwonwoo, calls him for guiding every day without fail. Although he thinks he has his hands full already, he's proven wrong when Kwonwoo loses eight years of his memories and his powers due to an accident on the job. Now it's up to Dowon to restore both by giving the mentally 20-year-old Kwonwoo the kind of intimate guiding he always refused before. But surprisingly, this cheery and affectionate Kwonwoo seems all too eager to take things to the next level...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

181547.description:
Ever since childhood, Hiroki struggled to express his feelings. Only his beloved dog Karo truly understood him. But one day in high school, Karo passes away...

(Source: Manga PLUS)

181548.description:
He's the perfect man- except when it comes to a certain crucial aspect. One day, an unexpected significant enhancement changes everything.

(Source: Toomics)

181549.description:
Lyle has no combat skills, only his role as a "repairer". He is treated as incompetent in his party, and his leader banishes him due to that.

Lyle is at his wit's end when a swordsman appears before him, asking him to repair an old sword...?
synonyms: The Exiled Former Errand Boy Is Now Known as the Greatest Repairman Through His Extraordinary Skills: Requests from SSS-Rank Parties and Royalty Keep Coming

title.native: 追放された元雑用係、規格外の技術で「最高の修繕師」と呼ばれるようになりました～SSSランクパーティーや王族からの依頼が止まりません～
title.romaji: Tsuihou sareta Moto Zatsuyougakari, Kikakugai no Gijutsu de "Saikou no Shuuzenshi" to Yobareru You ni Narimashita: SSS-Rank Party ya Ouzoku kara no Irai ga Tomarimasen

181550.description:
After being dumped by his boyfriend of 10 years, Jooyeong starts fresh at the only place that will hire him: a failing academy full of flunking students. When the director asks him to go on a show called "The King of Home Cooking" and promote the academy, Jooyeong dutifully agrees. What he doesn't expect is to run into Jonghan, the show's producer and his high school classmate who was much more than a friend. Their chance encounter sparks a heated fling behind the scenes, but all the while, the unresolved tension between them lingers like a ghost from the past...

(Source: Tappytoon)

181552.description:
The tale of Princess Ines is a tragic one. Born a royal of the Zener Empire, she is reviled and neglected as a child born out of wedlock. To compound her misfortune, Ines is married off to Grand Duke Ryan of Eleanor, a renowned war hero of the Lezan Empire who fought against Zener. Ryan proves a stern and distant husband to Ines, and she soon determines that she must fight for a life of dignity – if not in Eleanor, then elsewhere. However, a lapse in judgement leads him to the brink of disaster until a cafe regular Seo Yohan rescues him. As the heat of the moment escalates, Seonwu and Yohan find themselves entwined in an unexpected physical connection. Realizing that Yohan might have crucial information about the case, Seonwu seeks his help. Yohan, attracted to Seonwu, agrees on the condition that they become friends with benefits. Their unconventional relationship deepens, but as the investigation nears its end, Yohan abruptly cuts ties with Seonwu and seemingly dies in a car accident, leaving Seonwu heartbroken. Three years later, Seonwu, now hardened by his past, spots Yohan in footage from a new NIS sting—alive and well, under the alias "Yohan Romanov," a notorious Russian mafia member. Fueled by betrayal and unresolved trauma, Seonwu embarks on a mission to Russia, determined to confront the man who shattered his world.

Beetles, salamanders, and bug-eyed fish intrude upon the bus ride of the round-glasses woman as the night stretches on. Night Bus blends autobiography, horror, and fantasy into a vibrantly detailed surreal world that shows a distinct talent surveying his past.

This is an “epic coming-of-age golf comic,” that realistically depicts the human drama in the world of professional golf.

(Source: Golf Digest, translated)

title.native: 最強ヒーローボロボロスの休日

181704.description:
Jiang Shu is a graduate student in the History Department. When she accidentally travels back in time to the Qi dynasty, she remembers exactly how the history went. She knows that Qi Changning is a famously tyrannical queen, regarded as a villainess in the history books. Jiang Shu was content to play along and act like an obsequious lap-dog in order to survive. However, as she spends more time with the queen, she discovers details hidden from the history books. The "demon queen" doesn't seem to be as bad as what she had read…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Uno has someone he can't forget. He always had unrequited feelings for Murakami, who was popular with everyone even after graduating from university. He tries to put away his feelings by going to his friend's wedding, hoping to meet Murakami there one last time, but he finds out that Murakami is in debt and went missing! Murakami has lost everything and become homeless. Uno finds him, takes him in, and tries to conclude his unrequited love by living with him.

(Source: Libre, translated)

181708.description:
My family is a blended one. There's my illustrator mom, my office worker step-dad Nobu-kun, and my step sister Sarina who is a fourth grader like me. From now on we are one family, with our own challenges.

(Source: Densho Bato, translated)

181712.description:
In a quiet mountain village, an old serpent accidentally swallowed a mysterious cultivator's elixir—and in that moment, its mind awakened. From then on, it embarked on a perilous and exhilarating journey toward immortality. In just ten short years, it defied the ravages of time, racing against fate itself. It hunted demons, vanquished evil spirits, and carved its path against the will of heaven. This is the legendary tale of a serpent's ascension—from the dust of the mortal world to the boundless skies beyond. A saga of transformation, courage, and defiance begins.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Immortal Art of Becoming a Dragon
The Tale of a Snake's Cultivation to Immortality
Snake Immortal: The Tale of a Snake's Cultivation to Immortality

181713.description: The protagonist, Spear, is born with immense magical power and is confined to the "World's End", where those with magic are feared. Appointed as a warden, she suddenly recalls her past life as a farmer. Deciding to enjoy her second life, she uses her agricultural knowledge and powerful magic to live freely and pursue her passion for farming.
synonyms: A Second Life at World's End

title.native: 最果てのセカンドライフ

181714.description:
You've received a hidden job. Processing… Congratulations, Scavenger! Typhon Ye couldn’t afford to repay the high-interest loans that plagued him after a few failed investments, so his loan shark made him do illegal work for private parties to repay his debts. On one fateful day, Typhon struck down a monster he should never have been able to, and in that instant, experience points surged within him! He’d leveled up from Lv. 0 to Lv. 1! Typhon had triggered his once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to get a job! But the hands of fate had another plan for him, he awakened to a job unheard of in history -Scavenger! A “unique” job that revolves entirely around junk!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I Became the King By Scavenging

181715.description: The protagonist, Spear, is born with immense magical power and is confined to the "World's End", where those with magic are feared. Appointed as a warden, she suddenly recalls her past life as a farmer. Deciding to enjoy her second life, she uses her agricultural knowledge and powerful magic to live freely and pursue her passion for farming.

181716.description:
After drinking with a friend, Jeong-Ho falls asleep and wakes up the next morning with a hangover. The next morning, he hears the shocking news that his estranged wife, Mi-Young, has been murdered. At that moment, Jeong-Ho discovers bloodstains and a bloody knife on his clothes. He is identified as the strongest suspect and runs away from the police. Jeong-Ho wants to prove his alibi, but his vision is blacked out due to drinking the night before. He tries to prove his innocence by holding on to the fragments of memories that come to mind one by one and by tracking his whereabouts the night before based on the statements of other people around him, including a friend who drank with him the night before. However, as he pieces together his memories and the stories of those around him, he comes to the conclusion that he might really have killed his wife.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

181717.description:
I transmigrated into the novel called "The Treacherous Sorcerer" as a supporting character who's destined to be killed by Kian, the main villain of the story. According to the original plot, Kian ends up slaughtering every single noble in the empire-including me-so I must do everything in my power to stop him and save myself from an untimely death. Kian has survived a harsh and painful past, so I will spoil him and take good care of him so that he won't turn out to be the vicious supervillain! But what have I gotten myself into? After I rescued Kian from the slave market... he's suddenly obsessed with me!
Will I be able to protect Kian and myself from a disastrous fate?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

title.romaji: Akuyaku Dorei no Goshujin-Sama ni Narimashita

181718.description:
After eight long years away, Eunseo finds herself back in Korea. When her best friend Mi-yo offers her a place to stay while she gets back on her feet, Eunseo only ever intends to rest for a while before getting out of her hair. The problem is, Eunseo’s demons have come looking for her much sooner than she was expecting, and she soon finds herself facing one in particular. Kang Mido may be somewhat happy that she’s back, but he sure isn’t happy about her leaving in the first place. Determined to stop her from running away again, Mido resorts to drastic measures. Eunseo is in a predicament, there’s no doubt about that, but you know what they say: better the devil you know…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra chapter.

181719.description:
They have blocked and suppressed her mouth and ears toward the truth. Now that she is free from death, her revenge begins.

(Source: Comic Naver, translated)

181720.description:
Hankook University's Seo Jihyeok is the most popular professor on campus with female students. Because of this, he's had trouble finding a T.A. who can get the job done and not fall in love with him. The dean of his department thus decides to bring in Yoon Heemin as his new T.A. Perfect at her job, she also immediately tells Jihyeok that she has zero interest in him. Although happy to have a competent aide, things take a turn when Jihyeok realizes he might be the one falling in love this time.

(Source: Tapas)

181721.description:
I thought I would be the only one to swim into her heart, but I didn't realize she's the king of the sea! Facing an awkward situation from her very first encounter, Li Haijue decides to live freely — and embrace her role as the flirtatious "Sea King" — in order experience a very different kind of love story! Meanwhile, this other world's hidden mysteries are starting to reveal themselves. What does the “Sea King” title over her head truly mean..?

(Source: Billibilli, source)
synonyms: Will the Sea King Tip the Boat Today?

181722.description:
Kazuhiro Oyamada is a college student suffering from insomnia, causing his health to suffer. Kazuhiro decides to use his summer break to go back to his hometown to recuperate. When he arrives, he can't find his grandparents. Feeling something's off, he asks his parents about them, but they react suspiciously. That's when Kazuhiro discovers the "truth" of this strange mystery... This highly popular suspense-thriller finally has its comic adaptation!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: ぬらりひょんの棲む家

181723.description: While studying in the park one day, a boy comes across an anthropomorphic cat girl.

The days of never-ending competition begin!

181725.description:
After being pushed to her death by her husband, the emperor, Rosé Etwar wakes up years before their marriage. Vowing to avoid her cruel fate, she intentionally offends the imperial family and is sent to wed the mysterious King Maxim of the neighboring kingdom instead. Though initially suspicious of Rosé, Maxim agrees to become her ally and help destroy the empire, but he has his own conditions. Will Rosé be able to take her revenge, or will her imperial past haunt her royal future?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 皇后失格で申し訳ございません

181726.description:
Kang Yeon-U, who was born with a natural talent to become a shaman or entertainer, gains the ability to live longer after overcoming a near-death experience by resolving his grudge. After that, Yeon-U's life completely changes after meeting top star Kwon Seong-Hyeon while resolving a request...

(Source: Naver, translated)

181727.description:
Having always admired his father, Haruto chose to walk the path of a sake brewer. He and Nao, who were born into a family of brewers, were close enough to discuss their futures together. But after 10 years, their situation had changed drastically. They had hoped to support Nao's family's brewery together, but... Nao is no longer the heir?! Haruto is disappointed by his childhood friend's decision, but when he runs into Nao by chance, something seems different...

(Source: Kousai Shobo)

181737.description:
The beasthuman Noa has a dream of becoming a blacksmith, as Noa's father, Nomad, used to be the acclaimed Divine Blacksmith. Since Noa's mother died, Nomad has drowned his days in liquor and grief, so Noa ventures to dangerous places to get Nomad's smithing materials. This leads to Noa's life being in continual risk. Noa is now 14 and doing normal work as a smithy to support Nomad, when Nomad makes an unreal discovery about his child! All of the materials Noa's collected are unbelievably rare! Nomad calls his familiar adventurer to check Noa's level...and it's at an amazingly high 596! What's the secret to this super-high level, higher than even the kingdom's hero?! Check out this adventuring fantasy that unfolds around a puppy-human apprentice that's out of this world!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

181739.description:
Tasked with assigning a Hero to defeat the Demon Lord is an ambiguous figure known simply as the Prophet. As the priestess beholden to a particular god, she has the power to redo time until her chosen Hero successfully carries out his duty. Throughout her many time loops, one man piques her interest—a crass, money-grubbing adventurer who is a far cry from the ideal Hero candidate. Nonetheless, the Prophet taps him and his party to save the world. And though their doom seems all but inevitable, the Prophet can’t help but wonder if she’ll be able to defy fate with this inauspicious group…

(Source: Yen Press)

181741.description:
Low-ranking demon Kakyuu has amassed unparalleled power during his two millennia in hell. But when he gets caught in the cross fire during a battle between gods, he’s freed from that cruel life—and banished to another world altogether!! He finally has the peaceful, relaxed life he’s longed for, but peace doesn’t come easy…especially when the village that took him under its wing is razed to the ground. When he finds Alus, a baby who was left in the ruins of the village, this demon vows to repay his debt of gratitude—by making this baby the happiest child in the world!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Reincarnated Devil's Plan for Raising the Strongest Hero

Seto is an office worker who has come to enjoy being pampered by others while playing a female character named Rabi in an online game. One day, Kujou, a junior colleague who had just returned from a business trip overseas, was made his subordinate. For some reason, the bright and friendly Kujou has been very assertive in his attempts to get closer with Seto, saying that he wants them to get along better.

In the midst of all that, while Seto continues to play and interact as "Rabi" in the online game, that's when a player appeared, claiming to be looking for someone...

A second sex, Dom/Sub, emerged in the evolution of mankind. Doms dominate Subs and Subs are subordinate to Doms. The manga centers on Aoko, youngest daughter of the noted Jioka family, and Akira, the man who serves as her guard. Akira has been protecting Aoko since she was young, and while he protects and cherishes her, she does not know his true character. However, a certain incident causes the nature of their relationship to change.

With her cool demeanor and refined looks, the well-read Kaede Minato is revered by her schoolmates.

Momoko Hattori’s cute appearance made her a bit of an idol in the school right after enrollment. The two had virtually no interaction when Momoko’s chance encounter with Kaede promptly accelerates their relationship.

A romantic tale on the brink of love.

It's the Reiwa era and the infamous Shameless School is back yet again. Has anything changed since the first appearance in the Showa era? Or is it so that modern times can't fix a "masterpiece" of the past?

Note: This is a special one-shot published in Shonen Sunday Comics special "Mangaka Book Special Nagai Go Book".

181757.description:
Jack knows a thing or two about bombs. So much so, he’s earned the name “The Bomber” for his explosive endeavors as a mercenary. But after a particularly heavy job, the reward waiting for Jack is a summons to another world! Can this Jack of explosive trades prove useful in a totally different world, or will fate have other plans?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

181758.description:
Ga-hyun works in the HR department of a large corporation, responsible for training new hires and interns. As part of a global company that prides itself on being the industry’s best, she must properly train and shape these newcomers into capable employees. The problem is… she has no idea what the chairman’s standards are for selecting them. Because of his eccentric personality—and the fact that he personally interviews every candidate—Ga-hyun often finds herself fuming at the unique, often exasperating recruits sent her way. Still, Ga-hyun is a consummate professional. No matter who she’s assigned, she has the ability to mold them into employees who fit the company image. And it’s rewarding—seeing the trainees she’s mentored thrive and rise through the ranks always gives her a sense of pride. But the real satisfaction comes when these once-naïve rookies begin to see her not just as a superior, but as a woman.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

In the Church of Obscenity, coitus is the holiest of acts. Women of the nunnery are blessed with busty bodies that can only carry the child of God, so they offer themselves to men as practice partners. What would you like to do to this nun who lives in a quaint chapel?

She is afraid that she will never meet him again, but is that what fate has in store for them?

Virtue? Never heard of it...

181766.description:
Following the long, draining grind of her corporate life, Heeju feels as though her very soul is weathering away under the weight of endless deadlines and office politics. Just as she reaches her absolute breaking point, a mysterious, sleek flyer catches her eye, seemingly appearing out of thin air: [Women-Only Healing Massage Shop – OPEN EVENT!] Intrigued by the promise of a sanctuary away from the world, Heeju decides to indulge in a rare moment of self-care. However, once she steps inside the quiet, dimly lit studio, she realizes this is no ordinary spa. As the session begins, the therapist’s touch transcends simple muscle relaxation, delving into the deep-seated exhaustion she has kept buried for years. What starts as a professional treatment soon evolves into a series of clandestine, intimate sessions designed to awaken her dormant senses. In this hidden space, Heeju’s secret desires are finally addressed, leading her into a world of exquisite, private pleasure.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: What Happened at the Hypnosis Massage Shop
催眠エステでの出来事

181767.description:
Sewing machine, dress form, thread, and cloth. Akira Nitta sews costumes for idols in a room that has been engulfed by work. Her little sister sings and dances in the costumes she makes, her father lights the lights, and her brother plays the music.

"I wish these days could last forever.”
But these hopes are vain, and the family's peaceful days are torn apart by the cacophony of events that ensue.

Those memories are long gone, but one day, while watching a video of a live performance for work, Akira's eyes are drawn to a certain girl. This is a story of a family stitched together through idols.

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

181768.description:
Yukimaru is a science-oriented, bright, and somewhat innocent company employee, while Nishina is the “ace” clerk at an elementary school concept café who plays the role of the teacher. Yukimaru is always cold in body, and Nishina is cold at heart. One day, through a chance encounter, Yukimaru wanders into Nishina’s café. What follows is a sex journey with playful mischief and heated moments! The path to adulthood lies ahead, accompanied by irresistible twists and the cutest NO. 1 charm♡

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

181771.description:
Torao, a merchant with an unpopular profession, was a member of an S-rank adventurer party. However, being mediocre in combat and caught embezzling funds, he is told: "You're fired!" And just like that, he's expelled from the party. Left with no choice, Torao teams up with the girls on whom he spent the embezzled money, aiming to defeat the Demon Lord. But their first job is shockingly to recover equipment from the corpses of his annihilated former party...!?

"It doesn't matter. You're not my comrades anymore."

Even if they say, "We always thought we were comrades," it's too late now...

Planet Ar Ciel has been finally regenerated. Five years have gone by since that day, but the people of Sol Cluster still continue living in the Third Tower.
Right now, the lifespan of Tilia, who is also the Third Tower herself is coming to its end. Sol Cluster is plunged into chaos now they have to face her death, which also means the disappearance of the Tower. To save the people, Aoto and the others have started a plan of extending Tilia’s lifespan, but doing this means she will undergo a tremendous suffering.
A completely original story showing what happens after the popular PlayStation 3 RPG of the same name. Characters from the first two games also make an appearance and provide their help as everyone faces together the Third Tower’s disappearance. So, what will be Tilia’s final fate…?

However, Oto struggles with the strength of his commands, making him too intense for any sub partners he's had so far. Masa, on the other hand, has three regular partners. 181786.description:
An ordinary high school boy that you could find anywhere, Rio, had his ordinary life suddenly turned upside down one day. As he was skipping class like usual to take a nap at the infirmary, the tight-laced math teacher, Mr. Shiramine, came in together with Shuusei, a plain but beautiful male student. They then started having wild sex on the bed right next to him. The incredibly unusual, indecent scene unfolding right before his eyes made Rio both confused and aroused at the same time. Unable to get rid of the adult toy they had left behind, he ends up taking it home, wondering what to do with it. While the experience was something crazy enough to happen in a porn video, the whole thing left him feeling very flustered, when Shuusei then called out to him, "Give that back!"

Or did you want to kiss me?"

Oscar is an alpha who attacked his older brother when they were children. He finds a kindred spirit in Luca, also an alpha, when he goes to university in London. Both aiming to find their pair, Oscar slowly opens up to Luca, who is his exact opposite. One night, when Oscar confides in Luca that he hasn't been able to get an erection lately, Luca replies, "I'll help you get off"...? A wounded alpha finds his salvation through a minor miracle.

(Source: Libre, translated)

181789.description:
After her parents divorced, Lu Yang lived at her mother's best friend's house and lived with her daughter, Su Gui. Su Gui, bright and gentle, like the warm winter sun, easily illuminated Lu Yang's life, but also her heart. Lu Yang looked at her, like a sister, like a friend...

Later, Lu Yang didn't want to be her sister, she wanted to be with her. But after discovering that her feelings for Su Gui had deteriorated, Lu Yang did not want to break the harmony of the moment, and even more afraid of losing her "sister" identity, she could only tolerate dependence and move away from Su Gui.

However, after reuniting with Su Gui because of her work, the feelings she had been suppressing grew wildly, like branches of roses, wrapping herself and Su Gui tightly. Is it a long-planned plan or is it fate?

(source: Billibilli, translated)

181790.description:
Dating is a battlefield.

After attending a friend's wedding, high school teacher Shuu Kizaki decides to try out a dating app. Through a twist of fate, he matches with "Sakuran," one of the app's most popular girls with over 1,000 likes.

But there’s a catch—Sakuran turns out to be none other than his student, Saku—!?

"Sensei, you're totally clueless about how these apps work! Fine, I'll teach you how to become popular on the app!"

After rescuing Saku from a tough spot, Shuu is rewarded with tips on how to gain attention on the app. With her guidance, he dives headfirst into the battlefield of dating apps, searching for his perfect match—!

"In the face of justice, there are no taboos that should not be violated."

In the near future, humanity is in the depths of fear due to the onslaught of monsters. To protect world peace, the united Cross Rangers will enforce justice today! ...Or so it was supposed to be.

Cross Red, also known as Akama Retsuo, is a man who is passionate about justice. With an overflowing sense of justice, he commits a taboo one night with Cross Pink. And so begins the days of muddy, terrifying, immoral and ruinous...!

A suspenseful story of justice and immorality!

These cute, cartoony characters hate their lives and just want to escape! An official adaptation of The Amazing Digital Circus animated series.

Are you ready to witness the most jaw-dropping, heart-stopping, mind-bending paraphernalia you’ve ever laid your eyes upon? Then allow your ringmaster, Caine, to welcome you to the Amazing Digital Circus!

After putting on a strange headset she discovers in an abandoned building, a young woman finds herself inside the Amazing Digital Circus! Transformed into a cartoon jester named Pomni, she discovers she’s trapped in this glitchy digital world alongside a whole host of colorful characters. Will she be able to find the exit door and escape, or will she be stuck here until she loses her mind?

In love with Aizo from the idol unit LIP×LIP, Nakamura Chizuru (Chuutan) is a hard-core fan who refuses to share her oshi with anyone else!

She gives gifts, goes to events, and happily supports Aizo and Aizo only with her heart and soul! Working part time at a maid café to earn money to support her oshi, the cute and clever “Chuutan” is popular and living her best life...

Suddenly, a maid who is jealous of her appears?!

181803.description:
One day, an “alien portal” suddenly appeared. Known simply as “The Space,” the area now occupied by the aliens is said to contain a “wish machine,” an alien relic that can make any wish come true. In m-city of Tokyo metro, Ao Akashiro, a girl wearing a sailor-suit school uniform, often sneaks into “The Space” in search of the wish machine. The comet virus ravages the earth, and most of the world's humans are infected and become zombies. The remaining humans live in an underground city called the Shire. Xiao Yan, a rookie researcher, longs for a stable and lazy life. During a mission, he is saved by Hai Yin, a famous figure in the special mission force. Xiao Yan is deeply attracted to Hai Yin, and Hai Yin also begins to think about how to ensnare the rookie researcher...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

181808.description:
As a GM, Liu Yu entered the "Island of No Destiny" with the goal of becoming a [human]. He intended to use his "level-clearing shortcut" plug-in to get close to the "skills" of the boss to quickly clear the level, but each of his "skills" has various pitfalls. He thought this was already miserable, but then he met the strongest boss who ignored the "level-clearing shortcut" and insisted on crushing the whole map to clear the level at the last second. From then on, quickly clearing the level became a dream. Liu Yu and the boss, with different purposes in a dangerous world, went from pulling each other into hostility, to fighting together, and finally joining hands.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
