181819.description:
Arans, who had the best chance of taking the throne, was stabbed in the back by his most trusted subordinate, Volek, during the election campaign, and he was reduced from a high-ranking lord to Volek's concubine. However, Volek's betrayal was actually due to hypnosis by someone with ulterior motives, which magnified his desires and indulged his own means. But when he woke up, he found that he had hurt the person he loved the most and pulled him down from the altar with his own hands. In order to win back his lover, he begins to "chase his wife to the crematorium".

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: "Chase a wife to the crematorium" is an idiom meaning that someone who had once treated another badly before subsequently falling in love with them now has to endure all kinds of hardships in order to win them over.

181829.description:
Junsu is an ordinary college student who spends an extraordinary amount of time trying to beat a pay-to-win hero collector game called Arcane Seoul. All his hours of painstaking gameplay finally pays off when he lands Cheonma, one of the ultimate SS-ranked characters in the game, seconds before a truck runs him over. Now, he finds himself as Jeonsa Kim, a basic tutorial-stage character who can learn any skill. Can he use his gaming knowledge to survive the godforsaken, magic-driven, and monster-ridden alternate world of Arcane Seoul?

(Source: WEBTOON)

181838.description:
In order to practice the art of seduction, the useless nine-tailed fox Tu Shanqing was thrown into the "Mirror Flower World" by his sister, and he could not leave until he passed the test. But who can tell him why in the world of "Legend of the White Snake", the gentle and beautiful white snake disappeared, and was replaced by a hard and fierce man!? And he tried to stab him without saying a word?

In order to return to the real world, Tu Shanqing has to bite the bullet. But why is the way the male protagonist looks at him more and more wrong!?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Why Is the Male Lead Seducing Me

181840.description:
Su Ruhui, a Class A wanted criminal of the Secret Sect, died tragically due to illness. When he woke up, he found that it was five years later and he had become the newlywed husband of Sang Chiyu, the first disciple of the Secret Sect. Sang Chiyu was Su Ruhui's mortal enemy and the most prestigious military officer of the Kunlun Secret Sect. The former favored child of heaven, for some unknown reason, had his right leg crippled and was covered with whip wounds, barely surviving.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

181842.description:
As a behavior coach, Cheng Ran is good at finding human weaknesses to guide other people's behavior. He thinks he knows people's hearts very well: "The reward I want is... to kill you." Cheng Ran knelt on the ground, his hands and chin resting on Han Qi's knees, looking up at Han Qi's eyes like a puppy. "Start a fire, I will hold your body and burn it to ashes along with this house. Our ashes and the ashes of this world will be mixed together and can no longer be distinguished." Cheng Ran was confident that what he said at this moment was the love words that Han Qi wanted to hear the most. Han Qi was really stunned. "You can't burn a person to ashes by burning a house."

Han Qi stroked Cheng Ran's head with his hand, like comforting a puppy. After thinking for a while, he slowly said: "Put the body in the incinerator and burn it at a high temperature of 1000° for one hour, then use a hammer to break the calcified bones, and finally grind it finely to become ashes." Cheng Ran was surprised at Han Qi's understanding of the incineration process, and even more surprised that his thinking direction seemed to deviate from expectations. "Okay."

Han Qi looked into Cheng Ran's eyes seriously. Okay? ! Cheng Ran was shocked. What's good? I was just talking nonsense! I didn't really ask you to do it! Cheng Ran thought he was using the physical game to open the other person's heart, but he didn't expect that the other person was willing to accompany him into this taboo game.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

181843.description:
"Why can’t you like me…brother?"
"Don’t call me brother, it’s disgusting."

…So now that we’re in a dating game, why is this non-capture target who looks like my brother always pestering me?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

181844.description:
Helian Che’s family was destroyed by the demon tribe when he was young. He wanted to kill all the demon tribe, and the demon tribe was terrified of him. The fox demon Xiao Moyu finally cultivated into human form, but accidentally let his original body, which had the same five senses as his own, fall into the hands of the other party. Synesthesia is not a big deal, he can just endure it, but the problem is that if he loses his original body, he will die too!

Feeling the touch of the air falling on him, watching his original body being ravaged in the hands of the other party, Xiao Moyu could only disguise himself and blend in with the other party. Unexpectedly, this person became even worse, doing all kinds of strange things to his original body, tormenting Xiao Moyu so much that he couldn't sleep at night. Xiao Moyu endured the humiliation and finally took back his original body and got away. Unexpectedly, not long after he escaped, he was grabbed by the scruff of the neck and locked up by Helian Che. This time, it was not just the original body that was tormented...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A cunning adult, you might say.

Takatsuki is looking for a one-night stand at a men-only bar when his subordinate, Sone, discovers his plan. Sone embraces Takatsuki on the condition that he won’t tell anyone at the company about what Takatsuki was intending to do. Takatsuki can’t understand why Sone—handsome, talented, and with a promising future—would go to such lengths for a man like him.

“I can’t stand it if he dumps me again. I can’t fall in love anymore.”

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

A small splash in history, became an ocean that separated a family for half a century. Until a letter sent from Taipei in 1994 was able to bridge the waters.

At the grandfather's funeral, grandma and grandson finally have a conversation about the past. Back in the year 1948, the new China has just implemented land reforms. During this treacherous time, the Shen brothers, teaching at a private school, were accused of "unethical behavior." In a quiet little village, dark events unfolded, and in just a few months time, the Shen family would be torn apart.

This is a story about the life of an ordinary old lady from a village in China. Her story is but a single tear in the grand river of history, vanishingly small, yet truly poignant.

For three years, Omuro Rinko has dedicated herself to her dream job at Yatsuboshi Confectionery. While it hasn’t all been cupcakes and mochi, she’s proud of her hard-earned skills—until the day her boss assigns her to mentor the new hire, Shindou Ryoma. From the moment they meet, Shindou leaves a bitter taste in Rinko’s mouth. His sharp tongue and bad attitude grate on her nerves, and worse yet, he insists he doesn’t need her guidance at all. The most infuriating part? He’s right. Shindou isn’t just competent—he’s faster, more efficient, and outshines her at work. But what begins as a clash of personalities soon simmers into something far more intoxicating. After a company dinner, Shindou makes a bold move and asks to go home with her. To Rinko’s shock, the arrogant junior proves he’s not just skilled in the office—he’s devastatingly talented between the sheets, leaving her completely satisfied yet torn.

Now, as both her colleague and her lover, Shindou is pushing Rinko to her limits in more ways than one. If she wants to prove herself—at work and in the bedroom—she’ll need to step up her game. But how can she possibly keep up with her insatiable, irresistible junior?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A story about drinking at home together and ending up having sex with my otaku junior who's like a friend to me.

"You and I will never be in that kind of relationship", is what my junior told me.

I don't know whether it was because of the alcohol, or her own instinct that she ended up really enjoying herself while having sex with me, but before long she got sober and we found ourselves having some lovey-dovey sex this time.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)
synonyms: Drunken Sex with My Friendly Otaku Junior
友達のようなオタク後輩と●●えっち

title.native: 友達のようなオタク後輩と泥酔えっち
title.romaji: Tomodachi no Youna Otaku Kouhai to Deisui Ecchi

181938.description:
With his back against the wall, Crispin Tadelville, the last surviving alpha of the Tadelville family, disguised himself as an omega to escape death. Now, forced to bide his time as a plaything for the Ethelanian nobles who slayed his people, Crispin waits for the perfect opportunity to exact his revenge. His only obstacle? The prince of the Ethelanian empire he seems to have mistakenly marked.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: กับดักอสูร
囚われの獣に染まりて

181939.description:
Eunhyeong's world crumbles when her husband-to-be leaves her on their wedding day. While in a drunken stupor at home, she discovers an ad for a match delivery service on her phone. The next morning, a man named Minho shows up at her door, claiming to be her ideal match. What starts as a one-time free trial evolves into a routine of repeated orders, and sparks soon ignite between them as they find comfort in each other. Can they transform this unexpected twist of fate into a lasting love story?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes one prologue and seven side stories.

181940.description: A story about senior and junior editors working in the editorial department of a women's magazine.

181941.description:
In the year 2037, everything we know has changed. Humans are known across the galaxy as delicious treats, and have nearly been hunted to extinction. One lonely astronaut roams the Earth’s surface, searching through abandoned bunkers for his lost daughter. One day, he is surprised by a noise behind him. Out of the shadows steps a figure with fangs for teeth and tentacles for hair. But, instead of killing him, she introduces herself…?

(Source: SMA)

181942.description:
A story about a Hero(ine) who was raised as a boy and a certain warrior who was her former comrade, who has come to press her with a marriage proposal.

This is a romantic comedy style erotic manga, so if you like that kind of thing, this is for you. There's a difference in body sizes.

*The Hero(ine) refers to herself with "Ore".

(Source: DLsite, translated)

*Note: "Ore" is a masculine pronoun. Originally released as an adult doujinshi for men, a fully censored Teens Love version for women was later released on November 27, 2021 under the GirlsCREATIVE label.
synonyms: Marriage Proposal to the Hero (Actually ♀) When the World Is at Peace

title.native: 世界が平和になったので 勇者(実は♀)に求婚した結果
title.romaji: Sekai ga Heiwa ni Natta node Yuusha (Jitsu wa ♀) ni Kyuukon Shita Kekka

181943.description:
In Yuki Nanami’s class, a 3rd-year high school student, there was a man resembling a saint named Yatamori who exuded an aura that kept people away from him.

One day, Nanami comes across the notebook he usually uses for writing and finds out it contains a novel. Surprised by what he saw, Nanami goes to Yatamori’s house to express his feelings, only to discover him in the arms of a man, which makes him look nothing like the saintly image he had of him.

As he was tormented by that scene and couldn’t get it out of his mind, Yatamori asked him to pretend to be his new boyfriend to break up with his previous boyfriend.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: The chapter count includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: Prologue with Title Yet To Be Determined

title.native: タイトル未定のプロローグ

181944.description: Sayori Somei, a forensic scientist, has a "peculiar constitution" that allows her to "hear the corpse's voice" by talking to it. However, her daily life is disrupted by an "eerie corpse" brought in by Detective Takemoto.

title.native: 異常死体解剖ファイル

181945.description:
Eisei hasn't been close to his neighbour and childhood friend, Tsukiou, since he turned down Tsukiou's confession when they were younger. After his ex-girlfriend publicly revealed that he was bad at sex, Eisei stopped going to school. One night while feeling alone and depressed, he sees Tsukiou again, kissing an older woman in front of his house. Saying that he'll stay with him until he's ready to go back to school, Eisei spends his time in Tsukiou's room as if his confession never happened and his wounded heart gradually starts to heal... That is, until Tsukiou gets a text from an older woman; even though he had told Eisei he loved him, he put this unknown woman first. "If you don't want me to hate you, teach me techniques to have better sex." Tsukiou's gentle demeanor completely changes, and suddenly Eisei is completely at the mercy of Tsukiou's cruel-yet-incredible sex...?

No longer a child, not yet an adult.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

181946.description:
After his parents remarry, Na-Rim finds himself harboring a forbidden crush on his new stepbrother, Se-Wun. One day, he overhears Se-Wun’s “ideal type” is someone who knows their way around the bedroom - which causes Na-Rim, who doesn’t even have any experience with love or relationships, to panic. Hoping he can teach himself, he impulsively buys a box of sex toys. But when his friend Tae-Hyeon discovers them during a visit, he’s baffled by Na-Rim’s plan…only to make an outrageous offer instead: “Why not practice with me?” Does practice really make perfect, or is Na-Rim’s hope for some action a lost cause?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.
synonyms: セックスも練習が必要だ！〜ただいまレッスン中〜
ซ้อมเกมรัก

181947.description:
Reishin Saionji, a young man who was supposed to be at home, finds himself in a strange cabin. In the midst of his bewilderment, he suddenly receives a text message on his smartphone from someone who calls himself "the god of games and pleasures."

To his surprise, it is in response to a wish that Reoma suddenly muttered, inviting him to another world. In addition to giving Reishin a cheat setup for his phone, he also gets the privilege of being transferred as an extremely rare race of "demigods!"

Reishin, confused but excited that he has arrived in the other world he had dreamed of, follows the tutorial on his phone and heads for the town. However, as a Demigod, his surroundings do not overlook him...?
synonyms: As a Member of the [Demi-God] Race, I Want to Live a Normal Life in Another World

title.native: 種族【半神】な俺は異世界でも普通に暮らしたい
title.romaji: Shuzoku [Hanshin] na Ore wa Isekai Demo Futsuu ni Kurashitai

181948.description:
Kaho Kurahashi is a scenario writer who reincarnated as a villainess in the world of the otome game that she had made! From the cute heroine to the handsome love interests, she was excited to see all the familiar characters, when she encounters Zeke, the scariest-looking guy at school. Huh... Zeke is actually pure at heart?! Teaming up with a scary-faced guy, she'll make otome games in another world too!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Villain Daughter Wants to Make a Maiden Game Even if She Reincarnates in Another World! Why Am I Involved in Hiding My Hobby?

title.native: 悪役令嬢は異世界転生しても乙女ゲームをつくりたい！ オトメ趣味を隠していた俺がどうして巻き込まれているのだろう？
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Isekai Tensei Shitemo Otome Game wo Tsukuritai! Otome Shumi wo Kakushiteita Ore ga Doushite Makikomareteiru no Darou?

181949.description: Battle Scar is based mostly on true experiences of Ukrainian soldiers and civilians during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

181950.description:
Kina's friend group from college is made up of two girls and two guys. She had feelings for Tsukasa, one of the guys, but kept it a secret because he was dating her best friend, Rui. However, when Tsukasa and Rui announce their engagement, Kina aches with the feelings she thought she'd squashed, and she spends her days hating herself for struggling to find closure. To help plan the wedding, Kina meets up with Yutaro, Tsukasa's best friend. As the two are talking, Yutaro makes an unexpected suggestion...

This is a love story that starts with a lie and sprouts bittersweetly from the leftovers.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

181952.description:
Tohru Yanagi, aka BYDE, is an obsessive gamer with a penchant for fantasy tropes. It should come as no surprise, then, that after playing his favorite VR game "Last Fantasy" for 100 hours straight, his heart gave out and he died.

In the endless void after death, he met Celuenon, the god of gaming. Intrigued by his skills, Celuenon invites him to the world of Krenaklem, a land of swords and sorcery and all of those typical isekai tropes. Tohru accepts, and naturally is sent to another world.

So what's the catch this time, you might ask? In lieu of giving him any skills from Last Fantasy, Tohru instead was gifted a deck from "Monster and Magic Masters" - a physical card game he used to play in the past. And just like the trading card game, as long as he has the required mana he can summon any card from his deck, ranging from monsters to his faithful wolfgirl assistant Waff.
synonyms: Exploring Another World With Only One Deck

title.native: デッキひとつで異世界探訪

181953.description:
Upon awakening, a little girl named Lezay finds herself standing alone in an unfamiliar meadow. In front stands a massive dog. Such a creature had never been seen near home before. At that moment, a conclusion forms that this must be what is called reincarnation into another world. Soon, a band of muscular mercenaries appears, seemingly on a mission to subdue the giant dog. However, it turns out this dog is no ordinary beast, but a divine beast. The divine beast, Ranag, becomes deeply attached to Lezay, the only one it can communicate with. In response, leader Alragia offers to take both Lezay and Ranag under the protection of the mercenary troop...? A little girl, a divine dog, and a mercenary squad. This is a bizarre off-world fantasy with some strange members!

(Source: Alpha Manga)
synonyms: Reincarnated Girl: Living With a Beast, a Prince, and The Strongest Mercenary Group

title.english: The Reincarnated Little Girl Lives With Divine Beast, Prince, and Mercenaries of Tough Guys
title.native: 転生幼女。　神獣と王子と、最強のおじさん傭兵団の中で生きる。
title.romaji: Tensei Youjo. Shinjuu to Ouji to, Saikyou no Oji-san Youheidan no Naka de Ikiru.

synonyms: I'm the Only One Who Knows That Jobless Is the Strongest

title.native: 無職が最強であることを俺だけが知っている
title.romaji: Mushoku ga Saikyou de Aru Koto wo Ore Dake ga Shitte Iru

181955.description:
Ueno, a high schooler secretly yearning for romance novels, meets Yomoto, a fellow student who immerses himself in the cosmos without a care for others' opinions. Ueno decides to help with stargazing, and so their story begins!

A 54-page one-shot cheering on youthful dreams!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

181956.description: A father and his robot daughter have a heart-to-heart about what it means to be family and to be related.

181957.description:
Rio is a transfer student at a high school full of carnivores. Knowing how dangerous carnivores can be, Rio’s older brother advises him to lie about being a wolf when he’s actually a small dog. Even though Rio follows the advice, he’s immediately found out by his classmate, a cunning and flirtatious fox named Ryu. Ryu says he’ll keep Rio’s secret, but there’s a catch. He won’t do it for free...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 说谎的小狗会被吃掉的
title.romaji: Shuohuang de Xiao Gou Hui Bei Chi Diao de

181958.description:
1932. As the ominous footsteps of a turbulent era begin to echo, Eiko, the young lady of an elite aristocratic family and her cross-dressing female chauffeur Becky race through the changing times!

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

title.native: うっちゃれ五所瓦 粘り腰編

181960.description:
Is it justice or is it lawlessness? A vigilante thriller!

A university professor, Kazuo Tagawa, lives an ordinary, peaceful life with his only daughter, Momo. Then, something happens that shakes up their daily life—?

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

181964.description:
Bardium is a tightly guarded city where magic, miracles, and illusions aren't allowed. Here, in a dimly lit room, a young boy named Norman is being interrogated. He's asked about Unlaw-supernatural monsters who gain abilities from unstable emotion. Four of these beings, all beautiful women, are now hunting each other down, and Norman must sate their desires while dealing with other oddities cropping up all over Bardium. The city is in chaos, and yet, there is hope. Everything will come down to a single boy's words.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Winner of a Silver Award in the 30th Dengeki Novel Prize.

title.native: バケモノのきみに告ぐ、

181966.description:
I'm Liliana, the daughter of an earl, and I'm in a terrible bind. For some reason, when the “Ice Prince,” Prince William, hosted a party to find his bride, I was the lucky guest he chose to wed! Except…living a life as royalty is just about the last thing I want. So my goal is to break off my engagement—the sooner the better! But why is it that His Highness's attitude only grows sweeter day by day…?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: The Small-Animallike Lady Is Adored by the Ice Prince
title.native: 小動物系令嬢は氷の王子に溺愛される
title.romaji: Shoudoubutsu-kei Reijou wa Koori no Ouji ni Dekiai sareru

181967.description:
She refuses to be treated like a spoiled princess or a cute pet! But that only makes His Highness dote on her even more!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 小動物系令嬢は氷の王子に溺愛される
title.romaji: Shoudoubutsu-kei Reijou wa Koori no Ouji ni Dekiai sareru

title.native: 江戸天魔録 春と神

181969.description:
Kazuma Kuzuhara, a high school boy who proclaims “I don't want to work,” has two childhood friends. Yukina Kotoyu and Arisa Tsukishiro are members of the popular idol group "Dimension Stars!" The two became idols because they want to earn enough to support Kazuma for the rest of his life.......?

Kazu-kun, don't you dare do anything for any other girl but me!
I absolutely hate the idea of Kazuma being close to another girl.
I am the only one for Kazu/Kazu-kun/Kazuma.

Yukina and Arisa, because of their love for Kazuma, give him plenty of pocket money to spend. They also try to keep other girls away from Kazuma out of jealousy....... He spends all this time with his “childhood idols” who are single-minded but who also love each other very much.

(Source: Over-Lap, translated)

title.native: 幼馴染たちが人気アイドルになった
title.romaji: Osananajimitachi ga Ninki Idol ni Natta

181971.description:
Se-Hwa, who lives each day with a sense of loss and guilt after the sudden death of her beloved, attends a memorial service held at Sehwasa Temple, which shares her name. Se-Hwa feels an inexplicable sense of comfort whenever she visits the temple where her lover's memorial tablet is kept and eats temple food. A year of slowly healing her wounds and discovering the preciousness of everyday life and the value of existence. In a temple where food is made with seasonal vegetables, food stories continue with the flow of the four seasons. Se-Hwa encounters various foods as the seasons pass, and gradually changes. A story of reflection on life and death unfolds against a lyrical backdrop.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Sehwa, The Road To Go With The Flow

181972.description:
15 years ago, Kwon Kyeong-Chan is chasing the murderer who killed his sister. He becomes a police officer and hides his identity, chasing various evil faces that walk the world under the name of 'Black Sheep'. If he catches bad guys, he will eventually meet 'that guy' who killed his sister. He tracks down the criminals' activities without regard for the means and methods for revenge. He starts to cooperate with detective Kang Cheol-Ho, who is more gangster than gangster, and begins a full-scale chase. That guy starts to move again

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

181973.description:
"A realistic story scarier than a ghost"

The main characters of each story are caught up in the horrors that gradually emerge in their daily lives, and struggle to escape the nightmarish situations created by modern civilization.

(Source: Naver, translated)

181974.description:
1-4. Oshikake Dolce (おしかけドルチェ, Uninvited Dolce); Comic Anthurium 2022-04, 2022-08, 2022-11, 2023-04
5. Tabechatte Ii Desu ka (食べちゃっていいですか, Can I Eat You?); Comic Anthurium 2023-08
6-7. Harinezumi no Dilemma (はりねずみのジレンマ, Hedgehog's Dilemma); Comic Anthurium 2021-09, 2021-12
synonyms: I Wanna Attack You Because I Love You
食べちゃっていいですか
はりねずみのジレンマ

181975.description:
A story about having teasing sex with a girlfriend who's a senior at work.

It all started with a trivial thing, that the protagonist got the idea to have the kind of mean teasing sex with his girlfriend that would "make her want to cry out for release."

After repeatedly edging his girlfriend who wants to cum badly, he gets to see an indecent side of her that he's never seen before.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Note: Released at Comiket 99.
synonyms: Maximum Edging and Teasing Sex with My Senior

title.native: 先輩と限界まで寸止めイジワルえっち
title.romaji: Senpai to Genkai made Sundome Ijiwaru Ecchi

181976.description:
Adolescent boy x Adolescent girl

A pair who started dating after a successful confession.

She is the serious type of girlfriend who says, "We can hold hands after a week, kiss after a month, and anything more than that is after a year!"

However, one day on the way home, they get into a good mood and...

(Source: DLsite, translated)

181980.description:
A cute trap wants to be the girlfriend of a guy at his school but he knows that it’ll all fall apart when he confesses his true identity. Disheartened, he goes up to his usual thinking spot and contemplates jumping off… but it’s a little high! So he decides not to. At that moment, a witch appears and offers him some special incense completely free… but as always there is a catch!

1-8. Magical Incense; Koushoku Shounen Vol. 04-11

Note: Alternative version of Majissu serie earlier Published in COMIC RiN, This version focuses on Boys' Love content (with one Futanari episode).

181981.description:
"I didn't believe it. Until I saw it myself."

Kyung-Soo, who doesn't believe in ghosts, is forced to go along with his friends to a valley deep in the mountain in search of the water ghost. Somehow, he ends up all alone when he finds the water ghost there...

(Source: Naver, translated)

181982.description:
Born in the ruthless Exile Land where his next meal was never guaranteed, Moon has always aspired to no longer be a worthless human stuck at the edges of society. And while a once in a lifetime opportunity may pay out enough money to let him live his dreams, his road to riches is paved with games of death and survival. Can Moon survive long enough to see better days?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ブラックチョーカー・神の子の逆襲

181983.description:
A parallel game world merges with the modern world, and now ferocious monsters and alien races roam the land. In the wilds, there are many dungeons and hidden realms to explore. Humans have awakened news skills and professions, and they must defeat monsters to level up. On the day of the awakening, Lin Luo found himself with the profession of priest, which was the most popular class, but had no damage ability of its own. Just when he was wondering what to do, he discovered that his skills had mutated! His healing abilities now take away health instead? His blessings have turned into curses? But I am supposed to be a priest healer!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.native: 天生毒奶，我诅咒了全世界！
title.romaji: Tian Sheng Du Nai, Wo Zuzhou Le Quan Shijie!

181984.description:
Jung Eon is a maid who works in the house of a rich and powerful family. She dreams of escaping a life of servitude and saves every penny she earns. One day, she receives an unexpected proposal from her childhood friend and boss, Hyun Mae-hwa. He's as pretty as a flower, but has a horrible personality. Mae-hwa says he wants to marry her because of a prophecy that says Jung Eon has six benefactors in his destiny. He thinks she is the source of his financial luck. She accepts, thinking it's a chance to change her life.

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

181985.description:
Tangled up in some hairy business.

Office worker Nahee is working late when she gets caught in the crossfire between her boss and a would-be assassin. She's dragged into the secret world of human-animal shapeshifters, and it turns out her boss imprinted on her?! The two can't stand being together but can no longer bear being apart!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: CEO, You Son of a Bitch!

title.english: Keeping My Boss on a Tight Leash

181986.description:
The protagonist collects other people's personal information and spies on them. He hacks into the account of a male student in the same class that he admires and uncovers unimaginable activities. Shocked, P sends an anonymous message to scare him, and then the male student suddenly disappears. A few days later, the protagonist wakes up locked in a room with only one computer... Will the protagonist be able to find the criminal who locked him in the room with only one computer and escape?

(Source: Naver, translated)

181987.description:
Zelda von Trova never wanted the title of Acting Empress, but when she's forced to wed the Emperor of the Raphion Empire in place of the runaway princess, she has no choice. Yet after sharing the first night with him, her divorce plans begin to waver. As their attraction grows, Zelda’s heart is torn-- will she be able to walk away when the time comes, or will love unravel all her plans?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Deputy Empress, but Spent the First Night
The fake act of marrying a queen on behalf of her husband came true
The Empress's Wedding Night is Necessary
คืนเข้าหอของจักรพรรดินีจำเป็น
Als Ersatzkaiserin die erste Nacht v

title.english: The Acting Empress Still Spends the First Night

181988.description:
He may sound mean, but he just protects you silently without asking for anything in return!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

181989.description:
In a time when frozen humans are thawed, Dongwon, a twenty-nine-year-old baseball failure, welcomes his nine-year-old brother who has just woken up. He wants Hyungwon, who has the same face, to go down a different path, but nine-year-old Hyungwon's dream is still to be Hanyang's fourth batter. Dongwon wants to make his brother give up his dream without hurting him, and Hyungwon is just happy playing baseball with Dongwon. Can this dream-like relationship last?

(Source: Naver, translated)

181990.description:
Kang Pul's third romance comic. A story about the lives and love of seniors in their late 70s.

(Source: Namu, translated)

181991.description:
Princess Eudith’s story begins when her cruel brother, the king, sells her off to the neighboring kingdom to marry the queen’s powerless stepson, Prince Franz. Eudith becomes a pawn in the queen’s plot to discredit Franz and place her biological son, Krald, on the throne. Desperate, Eudith attempts to end her misery but wakes up on the day of her fateful journey. Armed with knowledge and experience from her past life, Eudith seizes the chance for revenge by helping Prince Franz take his rightful place on the throne. Will Eudith succeed in her revenge and find happiness?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Cup of Vengeance Is in Your Hands

181992.description:
After fleeing from his home during a family feud, Boris Jineman is left with only his brother and Winterer, the family's treasured sword. But when his beloved brother sacrifices his life for him, 12-year-old Boris becomes the sole guardian of Winterer in a world where this sword is coveted by all. As Boris struggles to fend off those who are after his family blade, his heart only grows colder and stiffer. Will this young boy be able to survive this winter to reach the spring that awaits him?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: บุตรแห่งรูน

181993.description:
Zhang Ping is tired of being seen as powerless, so he takes matters into his own hands by contracting himself with a forbidden gem. Now, with evolving powers and new challenges around every corner, he’s stepping into a world full of dangerous beasts and unpredictable enemies. His journey to survive and grow stronger has just begun.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Made a Contract With Myself

181994.description:
After suffering from an illness that cut his life short, Royce wakes up to find himself as a character from the story he read until his last moments. As a dragon hatchling, he believes his long life is just beginning. That is, until Royce realizes he's the son of the dragon who goes berserk due to his untimely death! Now, Royce is looking to race against the clock, even if his every move leads to a near-death experience. Will he be able to change his fate, or will he get stopped in his tracks?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Survive as a Dragon with Time-Limit
How to Survive as a Time-Limited Dragon
余命わずかなドラゴンが生き残る方法

title.english: The Dragon's Guide to Defying Death

181995.description:
When she was a student, she was a beautiful but cool loner. But 10 years later, we are married...... and she spends her days being all lovey-dovey with me! This is a collection of two-panel stories about the moe gap between the time skip, and the way she is becoming more and more doting on me!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published, the series was collected into a commercial volume published by Kadokawa on 2024-09-20
synonyms: クールな同級生の◯◯年後...
The Cool Classmate XX Years Later...

title.native: クールな同級生の10年後

181996.description:
Children--pure, innocent, and ready for a new beginning with their foster parents. But here at the Dead Mansion, those seemingly innocent features become lethal assets. Our orphans are schooled under the finest instructors, ensuring they meet your highest expectations and are sure to impress. However, these guardian angels come with a steep price tag. Perfection, after all, is a cruel mistress. Would you like to see the catalog now?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: กฎเหล็กบ้านสายลับ

181997.description:
When Lia Dellis comes across a dying man in need of help, she never could have imagined a curse would drive him to attack her. That's why she hits him over the head with a rock! Feeling guilty, Lia nurses him back to health only to realize that he's Dillian Synaize, the ruthless monster duke. To make matters worse, Dillian has lost all his memories and inexplicably thinks Lia is his wife. Can Lia escape the grasp of this so-called monster before he remembers that she was the one who hit him?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 怪物公爵に妻と勘違いされています

title.english: Mistaken as the Monster Duke's Wife

181998.description:
I transmigrated…twice. As Rari, I doted on Thierry so that I wouldn’t die at his hands later. But I was murdered anyway and, seven years later, I woke up as Princess Alicia Ashtad. Thierry became a ruthless tyrant in that time and, when he shows up in Ashtad Kingdom, I agree to leave with him to protect it. Now in Thierry’s palace, I must conceal my past life and, worse, someone wants me dead…again! Thierry may be the least of my worries.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Oh, I Have Never Abandoned That Tyrant
暴君様を捨てたことなんてありません

title.english: I Have Never Abandoned the Tyrant

181999.description:
A wielder of supernatural powers and a tool of war, Tsushima Rindou is an ordinary "informant," who takes on the job of smuggling Holy, the daughter of a fallen noble, out of the Balga Empire. However, this is just the start of swirling plots and conspiracies.

Their escape is not only being pursued by the regular Imperial army but also by the strongest informants in the Empire, known as the "Emperor's Six Swords." Why is such formidable power being deployed in secret against a minor noblewoman. The reason lies in Holy’s hidden identity.

Overwhelming enemies, layers of conspiracies, and past grudges to be settled. Despair so overwhelming to bring one to their knees. But—so what? When the two people, bound only by a transactional relationship, exchange a final vow, fear and despair will disappear!

A tale of a heretical knight, who has strayed far from the ideals of chivalry, begins here!

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)
